title: Vectors and coordinates · 向量与坐标
source: Week 1 prerequisite recap; explanatory examples are tutor-created, not official problem-sheet questions.
questionEn: How do we read a vector $\mathbf v=\begin{pmatrix}a\\b\end{pmatrix}\in\mathbb R^2$?
questionZh: 如何理解向量 $\mathbf v=\begin{pmatrix}a\\b\end{pmatrix}\in\mathbb R^2$？

overview.en: A vector has a direction and magnitude; coordinates tell us its horizontal and vertical displacement. Column notation is a way of recording those two components.
overview.zh: 向量有方向和长度；坐标记录水平与竖直方向的位移。列向量只是把两个分量竖着写出来。

prerequisites.en: $\mathbb R$ is the set of real numbers; $\mathbb R^2$ consists of ordered pairs of real numbers.
prerequisites.zh: $\mathbb R$ 是实数集合；$\mathbb R^2$ 的元素是有顺序的实数对。

strategy.en: Read the first component horizontally and the second vertically. Sketch an arrow from the origin before doing calculations.
strategy.zh: 先把第一个分量读成水平位移，第二个读成竖直位移。计算之前，从原点画一根箭头。

steps.en: $\begin{pmatrix}1\\2\end{pmatrix}$ means one unit right and two units up. Its position-vector arrow runs from $(0,0)$ to $(1,2)$.
steps.zh: $\begin{pmatrix}1\\2\end{pmatrix}$ 表示向右 1、向上 2；位置向量的箭头由 $(0,0)$ 指向 $(1,2)$。

steps.en: Moving an arrow without rotating or resizing it does not change the vector. This is why head-to-tail addition is possible.
steps.zh: 平移箭头而不旋转、不改变长度，不会改变向量。这就是可以把向量首尾相接相加的原因。

steps.en: Two vectors are equal exactly when corresponding components agree: $(a,b)=(c,d)$ means $a=c$ and $b=d$.
steps.zh: 向量相等当且仅当对应分量相等：$(a,b)=(c,d)$ 就是 $a=c$ 且 $b=d$。

say.en: Which component tells us how far to move horizontally? What changes if I reverse its sign?
say.zh: 哪个分量表示水平方向移动多少？如果把它的符号反过来，会怎样？

pitfalls.en: A point locates a position; a vector describes displacement. We often use the arrow from the origin to identify a point with its position vector.
pitfalls.zh: 点表示位置，向量表示位移。可以通过从原点出发的位置向量建立二者的对应，但不要把概念混为一谈。

pitfalls.en: The zero vector has length zero and no defined direction.
pitfalls.zh: 零向量长度为零，没有确定的方向。

title: Vector arithmetic and equations · 向量运算与方程
source: Week 1 prerequisite recap; explanatory examples are tutor-created, not official problem-sheet questions.
questionEn: How do we add, scale and rearrange vectors?
questionZh: 如何给向量做加法、数乘，以及整理向量方程？

overview.en: Work component by component. Rearranging a vector equation uses the same addition and scalar multiplication rules as an ordinary equation.
overview.zh: 逐个分量运算。向量方程的移项与普通方程一样，本质上是在两边加同一个向量或乘同一个标量。

prerequisites.en: The vectors being added must have the same number of components. A scalar is a single real number here.
prerequisites.zh: 相加的向量必须有相同数量的分量；这里的标量就是一个实数。

strategy.en: Resolve brackets first, then scalar multiplication, then combine corresponding components. In an equation, collect all copies of the unknown vector on one side.
strategy.zh: 先算括号，再做数乘，最后合并对应分量。遇到方程时，把未知向量集中到同一边。

steps.en: $\begin{pmatrix}a\\b\end{pmatrix}+\begin{pmatrix}c\\d\end{pmatrix}=\begin{pmatrix}a+c\\b+d\end{pmatrix}$ and $t\begin{pmatrix}a\\b\end{pmatrix}=\begin{pmatrix}ta\\tb\end{pmatrix}$.
steps.zh: $\begin{pmatrix}a\\b\end{pmatrix}+\begin{pmatrix}c\\d\end{pmatrix}=\begin{pmatrix}a+c\\b+d\end{pmatrix}$；$t\begin{pmatrix}a\\b\end{pmatrix}=\begin{pmatrix}ta\\tb\end{pmatrix}$。

steps.en: $\mathbf a-\mathbf z=\mathbf z-\mathbf b$ becomes $\mathbf a+\mathbf b=2\mathbf z$, so $\mathbf z=(\mathbf a+\mathbf b)/2$. Geometrically this is the midpoint of the two position vectors.
steps.zh: $\mathbf a-\mathbf z=\mathbf z-\mathbf b$ 可整理为 $\mathbf a+\mathbf b=2\mathbf z$，因此 $\mathbf z=(\mathbf a+\mathbf b)/2$。几何上，这正是两个位置向量端点的中点。

steps.en: Always substitute the result into the original equation. Both sides must produce the same vector, not merely the same length.
steps.zh: 最后代回原方程检验。两边必须得到相同的向量，而不是仅仅长度一样。

say.en: We can rearrange this just like an equation with numbers. What do we add to both sides to collect the unknown vectors?
say.zh: 可以像数字方程一样整理。我们应该在两边加什么，才能把未知向量集中起来？

pitfalls.en: Distribute a negative scalar to every component; do not change only the first sign.
pitfalls.zh: 负数数乘必须作用于每个分量，不能只改变第一个分量的符号。

pitfalls.en: Division by a nonzero scalar is allowed. There is no general operation of dividing one vector by another here.
pitfalls.zh: 可以除以非零标量；这里没有把一个向量除以另一个向量的通用运算。

title: Length and unit vectors · 长度与单位向量
source: Week 1 prerequisite recap; explanatory examples are tutor-created, not official problem-sheet questions.
questionEn: What do $\|\mathbf v\|$ and a unit vector mean?
questionZh: $\|\mathbf v\|$ 和单位向量分别是什么意思？

overview.en: The Euclidean norm is a nonnegative length. Normalising a nonzero vector keeps its direction and changes its length to one.
overview.zh: 欧几里得范数就是非负的长度。把非零向量单位化，就是保留方向、把长度变成 1。

prerequisites.en: Use Pythagoras in two dimensions; in higher dimensions sum the squares of every component.
prerequisites.zh: 二维里使用勾股定理；更高维时，把每个分量的平方相加。

strategy.en: Square, add, then take the nonnegative square root. Only divide by the norm after checking that the vector is nonzero.
strategy.zh: 先平方，再相加，最后取非负平方根。只有确认向量非零，才能除以它的长度。

steps.en: $\|\mathbf v\|=\sqrt{v_1^2+\cdots+v_n^2}$. Thus $\|(3,4)\|=5$ and its unit vector is $(3/5,4/5)$.
$\|t\mathbf v\|=|t|\,\|\mathbf v\|$. A negative scalar reverses direction, but does not give a negative length.
steps.zh: $\|t\mathbf v\|=|t|\,\|\mathbf v\|$。负标量会反转方向，但不会产生负长度。

steps.en: $\mathbf u(\theta)=(\cos\theta,\sin\theta)$ has length one because $\cos^2\theta+\sin^2\theta=1$.
steps.zh: $\mathbf u(\theta)=(\cos\theta,\sin\theta)$ 的长度为 1，因为 $\cos^2\theta+\sin^2\theta=1$。

steps.en: The zero vector has norm zero and cannot be normalised by division: division by zero is undefined.
steps.zh: 零向量的范数为零，不能用“除以长度”的方法单位化，因为不能除以零。

say.en: Length is a number, not a vector. If I double a vector, what happens to its length? What if I multiply it by minus two?
say.zh: 长度是一个数，不是向量。把向量乘以 2，长度怎样变化？乘以负 2 呢？

pitfalls.en: $\sqrt{a^2+b^2}$ is not generally $a+b$. Also $\sqrt{a^2}=|a|$, not always $a$.
pitfalls.zh: $\sqrt{a^2+b^2}$ 一般不等于 $a+b$；$\sqrt{a^2}=|a|$，不一定等于 $a$。

title: Polar and Cartesian coordinates · 极坐标与直角坐标
source: Week 1 prerequisite recap; explanatory examples are tutor-created, not official problem-sheet questions.
questionEn: How do we convert $(x,y)$ into $r\mathbf u(\theta)$ and back?
questionZh: 如何在 $(x,y)$ 与 $r\mathbf u(\theta)$ 之间转换？

overview.en: Cartesian coordinates give two components; polar coordinates give a length and an angle. They describe the same point or position vector.
overview.zh: 直角坐标给出两个分量；极坐标给出长度和角度。两种方式描述同一个点或位置向量。

prerequisites.en: Angles are measured anticlockwise from the positive horizontal axis. Use radians: $\pi/2=90^\circ$, $\pi=180^\circ$.
prerequisites.zh: 角度从水平正半轴逆时针测量。使用弧度：$\pi/2=90^\circ$，$\pi=180^\circ$。

strategy.en: Sketch the quadrant first. Find the nonnegative radius. Then choose an angle whose sine and cosine have the correct signs, and put it in the requested interval.
strategy.zh: 先画出所在象限，再求非负的半径。随后选择正弦、余弦符号正确的角，最后调整到题目要求的区间。

steps.en: From polar to Cartesian: $x=r\cos\theta$, $y=r\sin\theta$. From Cartesian to polar: $r=\sqrt{x^2+y^2}$.
steps.zh: 极坐标转直角坐标：$x=r\cos\theta$，$y=r\sin\theta$。直角坐标转极坐标先算 $r=\sqrt{x^2+y^2}$。

steps.en: For $r>0$, determine $\cos\theta=x/r$ and $\sin\theta=y/r$. These two equations locate the correct quadrant, including points on the axes.
steps.zh: 当 $r>0$ 时，用 $\cos\theta=x/r$、$\sin\theta=y/r$ 确定方向；两条条件一起使用，可以处理象限与坐标轴上的点。

steps.en: For $(-1,1)$, $r=\sqrt2$ and $\theta=3\pi/4$ in $[0,2\pi)$. Using only $\arctan(y/x)=-\pi/4$ would point in the wrong direction.
steps.zh: 例如 $(-1,1)$ 的 $r=\sqrt2$，在 $[0,2\pi)$ 内应取 $\theta=3\pi/4$。若只算 $\arctan(y/x)=-\pi/4$，会指向错误方向。

steps.en: Angles differing by $2\pi m$, $m\in\mathbb Z$, describe the same direction. For the zero vector, $r=0$ and any angle gives the same point; it cannot have a representation with $r>0$.
steps.zh: 相差 $2\pi m$（$m\in\mathbb Z$）的角表示同一方向。零向量的 $r=0$，任意角都得到原点；它不能写成半径严格大于零的形式。

say.en: The radius tells us how far; the angle tells us which way. Before using a calculator, which quadrant should the answer be in?
say.zh: 半径告诉我们走多远，角度告诉我们朝哪里走。按计算器之前，先判断答案应该在哪个象限。

pitfalls.en: $\tan\theta=y/x$ loses quadrant information and is unavailable when $x=0$. On an axis, read the direction directly.
pitfalls.zh: $\tan\theta=y/x$ 会丢失象限信息，而且 $x=0$ 时不能用。在坐标轴上，直接判断方向更清楚。

pitfalls.en: If the question requires a positive radius, do not give a negative radius with an adjusted angle.
pitfalls.zh: 题目如果要求半径为正，就不要给负半径配一个调整后的角度。

title: Complex numbers and the Argand plane · 复数与复平面
source: Week 1 prerequisite recap; explanatory examples are tutor-created, not official problem-sheet questions.
questionEn: How is $z=a+bi$ represented geometrically?
questionZh: 如何在几何上表示 $z=a+bi$？

overview.en: A complex number has real and imaginary parts. The Argand plane draws these as horizontal and vertical coordinates.
overview.zh: 复数有实部和虚部。在复平面上，实部对应横坐标，虚部对应纵坐标。

prerequisites.en: $i^2=-1$. For real $a,b$, $\operatorname{Re}(a+bi)=a$ and $\operatorname{Im}(a+bi)=b$.
prerequisites.zh: $i^2=-1$。对于实数 $a,b$，$\operatorname{Re}(a+bi)=a$，$\operatorname{Im}(a+bi)=b$。

strategy.en: Read the two coefficients, plot the point, then connect it to the origin to discuss modulus and argument.
strategy.zh: 先读出两个系数、画出点，然后把它与原点相连，讨论模和辐角。

steps.en: $a+bi$ corresponds to $(a,b)$. Its modulus is $|z|=\sqrt{a^2+b^2}$, the distance from the origin.
steps.zh: $a+bi$ 对应点 $(a,b)$，模为 $|z|=\sqrt{a^2+b^2}$，就是它到原点的距离。

steps.en: For $z\ne0$, a polar form is $z=r(\cos\theta+i\sin\theta)$, where $r=|z|>0$. Equivalently, if exponential notation has been introduced, $z=re^{i\theta}$.
steps.zh: 对于 $z\ne0$，极形式为 $z=r(\cos\theta+i\sin\theta)$，其中 $r=|z|>0$。如果已经学过指数记法，也可以写成 $z=re^{i\theta}$。

steps.en: An argument is not unique: $\theta+2\pi m$ gives the same nonzero complex number for every integer $m$. The argument of zero is undefined.
steps.zh: 辐角不是唯一的：对于每个整数 $m$，$\theta+2\pi m$ 都表示同一个非零复数。零的辐角没有定义。

say.en: Which part goes on the horizontal axis? Where is a number with a negative imaginary part?
say.zh: 哪个部分放在横轴上？虚部是负数时，点在什么位置？

pitfalls.en: The imaginary part of $2-i$ is $-1$, not $-i$. The number $i$ is part of the notation; the imaginary part is a real coefficient.
pitfalls.zh: $2-i$ 的虚部是 $-1$，不是 $-i$。虚部指实数系数，不包含记号 $i$。

pitfalls.en: Do not confuse a complex number with its modulus: one contains direction information, while the other is only a nonnegative real number.
pitfalls.zh: 不要混淆复数与其模：复数包含方向信息，模只是一个非负实数。

title: Conjugates and complex division · 共轭与复数除法
source: Week 1 prerequisite recap; explanatory examples are tutor-created, not official problem-sheet questions.
questionEn: Why do we multiply by the conjugate when dividing complex numbers?
questionZh: 复数除法为什么要乘以分母的共轭？

overview.en: The conjugate flips the imaginary sign. Multiply BOTH numerator and denominator by the conjugate of a nonzero denominator: the value stays unchanged and the new denominator is positive and real.
overview.zh: 共轭反转虚部符号。把分子、分母同时乘以非零分母的共轭，分式的值不变，新分母则是正实数。

prerequisites.en: $\overline{a+bi}=a-bi$ and $i^2=-1$. A quotient is defined only when its denominator is nonzero.
prerequisites.zh: $\overline{a+bi}=a-bi$，并且 $i^2=-1$。只有分母非零时，除法才有定义。

strategy.en: Look for a conjugate product before expanding everything. If an imaginary term remains in the denominator, multiply both numerator and denominator by its conjugate.
strategy.zh: 先观察有没有共轭乘积，不必一上来全部展开。若分母仍含虚数部分，就把分子、分母同时乘以分母的共轭。

steps.en: $(a+bi)(a-bi)=a^2-(bi)^2=a^2+b^2$. The plus sign comes from $i^2=-1$.
For $c+di\ne0$, $\displaystyle\frac{a+bi}{c+di}=\frac{(a+bi)(c-di)}{c^2+d^2}$. Since $c^2+d^2>0$, we may divide by this real denominator.
steps.zh: 当 $c+di\ne0$ 时，$\displaystyle\frac{a+bi}{c+di}=\frac{(a+bi)(c-di)}{c^2+d^2}$。此时 $c^2+d^2>0$，可以正常除以这个实数分母。

steps.en: Collect the real and imaginary terms to obtain $\displaystyle\frac{ac+bd}{c^2+d^2}+i\frac{bc-ad}{c^2+d^2}$. This is a derived check, not a formula students need to memorise here.
steps.zh: 合并实部、虚部可得 $\displaystyle\frac{ac+bd}{c^2+d^2}+i\frac{bc-ad}{c^2+d^2}$。这是推导后的核对式，本节不必要求学生死记。

steps.en: Check by multiplying the answer by the original denominator; it should recover the original numerator.
steps.zh: 检验时，把答案乘回原分母，应恢复原来的分子。

say.en: What could we multiply this denominator by to make it real? Whatever we do to the denominator, what must we also do to the numerator?
say.zh: 分母乘什么会变成实数？分母做了这个操作，分子还必须做什么？

pitfalls.en: Multiplying only the denominator changes the value. Multiply the whole fraction by one, written as conjugate over conjugate.
pitfalls.zh: 只乘分母会改变数值。应当把整个分式乘以“共轭除以共轭”，也就是乘以 1。

pitfalls.en: There is no division by the zero complex number.
pitfalls.zh: 不能除以零复数。

title: Dot products and angles · 点积与夹角
source: Week 1 prerequisite recap; explanatory examples are tutor-created, not official problem-sheet questions.
questionEn: How does the dot product determine the angle between two nonzero vectors?
questionZh: 点积如何确定两个非零向量的夹角？

overview.en: The dot product is a scalar. One formula computes it from coordinates; another connects it to lengths and the cosine of the angle.
overview.zh: 点积的结果是一个标量。一个公式用坐标计算，另一个公式把它与长度及夹角的余弦联系起来。

prerequisites.en: For nonzero vectors, take the angle $\theta\in[0,\pi]$. Norms are positive, so division by their product is valid.
prerequisites.zh: 两个非零向量的夹角取 $\theta\in[0,\pi]$。它们的范数都大于零，因此可以除以范数的乘积。

strategy.en: Compute the dot product first; calculate each norm separately; divide once at the end. Use the sign as a geometric check.
strategy.zh: 先算点积，再分别算两个范数，最后做除法。用正负号作几何检查。

steps.en: $\mathbf a\cdot\mathbf b=a_1b_1+\cdots+a_nb_n$; the result is a number, not a vector.
steps.zh: $\mathbf a\cdot\mathbf b=a_1b_1+\cdots+a_nb_n$；结果是一个数，不是向量。

steps.en: $\mathbf a\cdot\mathbf b=\|\mathbf a\|\,\|\mathbf b\|\cos\theta$, hence $\displaystyle\cos\theta=\frac{\mathbf a\cdot\mathbf b}{\|\mathbf a\|\,\|\mathbf b\|}$.
steps.zh: $\mathbf a\cdot\mathbf b=\|\mathbf a\|\,\|\mathbf b\|\cos\theta$，因此 $\displaystyle\cos\theta=\frac{\mathbf a\cdot\mathbf b}{\|\mathbf a\|\,\|\mathbf b\|}$。

steps.en: For nonzero vectors, a positive dot product means an angle smaller than 90° (including 0°); zero means 90°; a negative dot product means an angle larger than 90° (including 180°).
steps.zh: 对于非零向量，点积为正表示夹角小于 90°（包括 0°）；为零表示 90°；为负表示夹角大于 90°（包括 180°）。

steps.en: The cosine must lie in $[-1,1]$. A value outside that interval flags an arithmetic or denominator error.
steps.zh: 余弦必须位于 $[-1,1]$；超出这个区间，说明算术或分母有误。

say.en: Is this dot product positive or negative? Before finding an exact angle, what does that already tell us?
say.zh: 点积是正还是负？在计算具体角度之前，这已经告诉我们什么？

pitfalls.en: If either vector is zero, its dot product with every vector is zero, but the angle formula is undefined. Do not infer a right angle with the zero vector.
pitfalls.zh: 只要其中一个是零向量，点积就为零，但夹角公式没有定义。不要因此说零向量与别的向量夹角是直角。

pitfalls.en: If asked only for the cosine, leave an exact cosine; there is no need to use inverse cosine or rounded degrees.
pitfalls.zh: 如果题目只问余弦，就给精确余弦值，不需要再求反余弦或近似角度。

title: Triangle inequality and equality · 三角不等式与等号
source: Week 1 prerequisite recap; explanatory examples are tutor-created, not official problem-sheet questions.
questionEn: What does $\|\mathbf a+\mathbf b\|\le\|\mathbf a\|+\|\mathbf b\|$ say?
questionZh: $\|\mathbf a+\mathbf b\|\le\|\mathbf a\|+\|\mathbf b\|$ 表示什么？

overview.en: The direct displacement cannot be longer than the two-step route. This is a tool for bounding a length, not a rule saying lengths always add.
overview.zh: 直接位移的长度，不会大于分两段走的路程。这是给长度作上界的工具，不是在说长度永远可以直接相加。

prerequisites.en: Draw vectors head-to-tail. Their sum goes from the start of the first arrow to the end of the second.
prerequisites.zh: 把向量首尾相接；和向量从第一根箭头起点指向第二根箭头终点。

strategy.en: Name the two vectors to which you are applying the inequality. A sum of several vectors can itself be treated as one vector.
strategy.zh: 每次使用时明确：哪两个向量在应用三角不等式？多个向量的和也可以看成一个向量。

steps.en: For $\mathbf a=(1,0)$ and $\mathbf b=(0,1)$, the direct length is $\sqrt2$, while the two-step route has length $2$. Thus the inequality can be strict.
steps.zh: 例如 $\mathbf a=(1,0)$、$\mathbf b=(0,1)$ 时，直接长度为 $\sqrt2$，分段路程为 $2$，所以不等式可能严格成立。

steps.en: Equality holds for two nonzero Euclidean vectors exactly when they point in the same direction. More precisely, all cases can be written $\mathbf a=s\mathbf q$, $\mathbf b=t\mathbf q$ with $s,t\ge0$ and some vector $\mathbf q$.
steps.zh: 两个非零欧几里得向量取等号，当且仅当它们同向。包含零向量在内的统一表述是：存在向量 $\mathbf q$ 和 $s,t\ge0$，使 $\mathbf a=s\mathbf q$、$\mathbf b=t\mathbf q$。

steps.en: If one vector is zero, equality holds. If two nonzero vectors point in opposite directions, cancellation makes the inequality strict.
steps.zh: 一个向量为零时取等号。两个非零向量方向相反时，会相互抵消，不等式严格成立。

steps.en: A proof check: expand $\|\mathbf a+\mathbf b\|^2=\|\mathbf a\|^2+2\mathbf a\cdot\mathbf b+\|\mathbf b\|^2$ and use $\mathbf a\cdot\mathbf b\le\|\mathbf a\|\|\mathbf b\|$. Taking square roots preserves the inequality because both sides are nonnegative.
steps.zh: 证明核对：展开 $\|\mathbf a+\mathbf b\|^2=\|\mathbf a\|^2+2\mathbf a\cdot\mathbf b+\|\mathbf b\|^2$，再用 $\mathbf a\cdot\mathbf b\le\|\mathbf a\|\|\mathbf b\|$。两边都非负，因此可以开平方而保留不等号方向。

say.en: Imagine walking along the two arrows. When would that route be exactly as short as going straight to the endpoint?
say.zh: 想象沿着两根箭头走。什么情况下，这条路线恰好与直接走到终点一样短？

pitfalls.en: “Parallel” alone is insufficient for equality: opposite directions are parallel too. Say “same direction”, with zero vectors handled separately.
pitfalls.zh: 仅说“平行”还不够，因为反向也平行。应该说“同向”，并单独照顾零向量情形。

pitfalls.en: Tutor boundary: do not turn this recap into a walkthrough of the submitted Week 2 hand-in. The specific hand-in and its full solution are kept in C1 for tutor preparation only.
pitfalls.zh: 教学边界：不要把概念回顾变成对 Week 2 要提交作业的完整讲解。该题的具体解答单独放在 C1，只供教师备课。

title: Cauchy–Schwarz and equality · 柯西–施瓦茨不等式
source: Week 1 problem-sheet prerequisite recap; explanatory examples are tutor-created, not additional official questions.
questionEn: What does $|\mathbf a\cdot\mathbf b|\le\|\mathbf a\|\|\mathbf b\|$ say, and when is there equality?
questionZh: $|\mathbf a\cdot\mathbf b|\le\|\mathbf a\|\|\mathbf b\|$ 表示什么，什么时候取等号？

overview.en: This bounds the absolute size of a dot product. For real Euclidean vectors, equality means linear dependence, including zero-vector cases.
overview.zh: 它给点积绝对值作上界。对于实欧几里得向量，取等号等价于线性相关，包括零向量情形。

prerequisites.en: Recall dot products and norms. Two vectors are linearly dependent if some linear combination with coefficients not both zero equals zero.
prerequisites.zh: 回顾点积与范数。两个向量线性相关，表示存在不全为零的系数，使其线性组合为零。

strategy.en: Recognise a sum of products as a dot product, and two sums of squares as squared norms.
strategy.zh: 把乘积之和识别为点积，把两组平方和识别为范数的平方。

steps.en: The squared version is $(\mathbf a\cdot\mathbf b)^2\le(\mathbf a\cdot\mathbf a)(\mathbf b\cdot\mathbf b)$.
steps.zh: 平方形式为 $(\mathbf a\cdot\mathbf b)^2\le(\mathbf a\cdot\mathbf a)(\mathbf b\cdot\mathbf b)$。

steps.en: If $\mathbf b\ne\mathbf0$, expand $0\le\|\mathbf a-t\mathbf b\|^2$ at $t=(\mathbf a\cdot\mathbf b)/\|\mathbf b\|^2$. This gives $0\le\|\mathbf a\|^2-(\mathbf a\cdot\mathbf b)^2/\|\mathbf b\|^2$. Multiplying by the positive denominator proves the inequality.
steps.zh: 若 $\mathbf b\ne\mathbf0$，在 $t=(\mathbf a\cdot\mathbf b)/\|\mathbf b\|^2$ 处展开 $0\le\|\mathbf a-t\mathbf b\|^2$，得到 $0\le\|\mathbf a\|^2-(\mathbf a\cdot\mathbf b)^2/\|\mathbf b\|^2$。乘以正的分母即得结论。

steps.en: Equality means $\mathbf a=t\mathbf b$, with t allowed to be negative. If $\mathbf b=\mathbf0$, both sides are zero, so no division is needed.
steps.zh: 取等号意味着 $\mathbf a=t\mathbf b$，t 可以为负。若 $\mathbf b=\mathbf0$，两边都是零，无需除法。

say.en: Which vectors make this expression a dot product? Does the absolute value allow opposite directions?
say.zh: 用哪两个向量可以把表达式写成点积？有绝对值时，方向相反能取等号吗？

pitfalls.en: Unlike triangle equality, equality here permits opposite directions because of the absolute value.
pitfalls.zh: 不同于三角不等式的等号，这里的绝对值允许反向向量取等号。

title: Euler and de Moivre · 欧拉形式与棣莫弗公式
source: Week 1 problem-sheet prerequisite recap; explanatory examples are tutor-created, not additional official questions.
questionEn: How do polar forms simplify complex multiplication and integer powers?
questionZh: 极形式如何简化复数乘法与整数次幂？

overview.en: Multiply moduli and add arguments. Integer powers repeat that operation.
overview.zh: 模相乘、辐角相加；整数次幂就是重复这一操作。

prerequisites.en: $e^{i\theta}=\cos\theta+i\sin\theta$ packages the same unit-circle point.
prerequisites.zh: $e^{i\theta}=\cos\theta+i\sin\theta$ 是同一个单位圆上的点的紧凑记法。

strategy.en: Find modulus and argument first. Do length and angle calculations separately, then return to Cartesian form if requested.
strategy.zh: 先求模与辐角，分开计算长度与角度，再按要求转回直角形式。

steps.en: $(re^{i\theta})(se^{i\phi})=rs e^{i(\theta+\phi)}$. For $s>0$, division gives $(r/s)e^{i(\theta-\phi)}$.
steps.zh: $(re^{i\theta})(se^{i\phi})=rs e^{i(\theta+\phi)}$。当 $s>0$ 时，相除得到 $(r/s)e^{i(\theta-\phi)}$。

steps.en: For integers m, $(re^{i\theta})^m=r^m e^{im\theta}$ when defined; in particular $(\cos\theta+i\sin\theta)^m=\cos(m\theta)+i\sin(m\theta)$. Negative powers require a nonzero base.
steps.zh: 整数 m 满足 $(re^{i\theta})^m=r^m e^{im\theta}$（在有定义时）；特别地 $(\cos\theta+i\sin\theta)^m=\cos(m\theta)+i\sin(m\theta)$。负整数幂要求底数非零。

steps.en: Example: $1+i=\sqrt2e^{i\pi/4}$, so $(1+i)^4=4e^{i\pi}=-4$. Check by squaring twice: $(1+i)^2=2i$, then $(2i)^2=-4$.

say.en: What happens to the moduli? What happens to the angles?
say.zh: 模怎样变化？角度怎样变化？

pitfalls.en: Do not multiply arguments together: multiplication adds them. Fractional powers need multiple-root and branch care; do not assume one answer.
pitfalls.zh: 不要把辐角相乘，乘法对应辐角相加。分数次幂涉及多个根与分支，不能默认只有一个答案。

title: Complex roots and roots of unity · 复数开根与单位根
source: Week 1 problem-sheet prerequisite recap; explanatory examples are tutor-created, not additional official questions.
questionEn: Find all solutions of $z^m=w$, where m is a positive integer.
questionZh: 正整数 m 时，如何求出 $z^m=w$ 的所有解？

overview.en: Nonzero w has m distinct mth roots, equally spaced on a circle.
overview.zh: 非零 w 有 m 个不同的 m 次根，在圆周上均匀分布。

prerequisites.en: Use de Moivre and remember all arguments differing by a full turn.
prerequisites.zh: 使用棣莫弗公式，并保留所有相差整圈的辐角。

strategy.en: Write the target in polar form. Solve the modulus, then divide all angle possibilities by m. List m consecutive integer choices.
strategy.zh: 先把目标写成极形式，求模，再将所有可能角度除以 m。列出连续 m 个整数对应的答案。

steps.en: For $w=Re^{i\phi}$, $R>0$, the roots are $z_j=R^{1/m}e^{i(\phi+2\pi j)/m}$, $j=0,\ldots,m-1$. Each raised to the mth power gives w.
steps.zh: 当 $w=Re^{i\phi}$、$R>0$ 时，根为 $z_j=R^{1/m}e^{i(\phi+2\pi j)/m}$，$j=0,\ldots,m-1$；任一根的 m 次幂都等于 w。

steps.en: For $w=1$, roots of unity are $e^{2\pi ij/m}$. For m=3, these are $1$, $-1/2+i\sqrt3/2$, $-1/2-i\sqrt3/2$.
Adding m to j repeats a root. For $w=0$, the only distinct solution is $z=0$, so no argument is needed.
steps.zh: j 增加 m 会重复已有的根。$w=0$ 时，唯一不同的解为 $z=0$，无需使用辐角。

say.en: If you found just one root, where did the other full turns of the argument go?
say.zh: 若只找到一个根，原来加整圈的其他角度去哪里了？

pitfalls.en: Divide the whole $\phi+2\pi j$ by m. Do not include j=m as a new root; it repeats j=0.
pitfalls.zh: 把整个 $\phi+2\pi j$ 除以 m。j=m 不算新根，因为它重复 j=0。

title: Rationalising in Q(√2) · 在 Q(√2) 中有理化
source: Week 1 problem-sheet prerequisite recap; explanatory examples are tutor-created, not additional official questions.
questionEn: Simplify $1/(a+b\sqrt2)$ for rational a,b and a nonzero denominator.
questionZh: a、b 是有理数且分母非零时，如何化简 $1/(a+b\sqrt2)$？

overview.en: Change the sign of the radical part to make a difference of squares. The result remains rational plus rational times √2.
overview.zh: 改变根式部分的符号以形成平方差，结果仍是“有理数加有理数乘 √2”。

prerequisites.en: $\mathbb Q(\sqrt2)=\{a+b\sqrt2:a,b\in\mathbb Q\}$ and $\sqrt2$ is irrational.
prerequisites.zh: $\mathbb Q(\sqrt2)=\{a+b\sqrt2:a,b\in\mathbb Q\}$，而 $\sqrt2$ 是无理数。

strategy.en: Multiply by a−b√2 above and below; justify why the new denominator cannot vanish.
strategy.zh: 分子、分母同时乘以 a−b√2，并解释新分母为什么不能为零。

steps.en: $\displaystyle\frac1{a+b\sqrt2}=\frac{a-b\sqrt2}{a^2-2b^2}=\frac a{a^2-2b^2}-\frac b{a^2-2b^2}\sqrt2$.
steps.zh: $\displaystyle\frac1{a+b\sqrt2}=\frac{a-b\sqrt2}{a^2-2b^2}=\frac a{a^2-2b^2}-\frac b{a^2-2b^2}\sqrt2$。

steps.en: If $a^2=2b^2$ and $b\ne0$, then $|a/b|=\sqrt2$, impossible for rational a,b. If b=0, then a=0, contradicting the original nonzero denominator. Thus $a^2-2b^2\ne0$.
steps.zh: 若 $a^2=2b^2$ 且 $b\ne0$，则 $|a/b|=\sqrt2$，与 a、b 有理矛盾。若 b=0，则 a=0，与原分母非零矛盾。因此 $a^2-2b^2\ne0$。

steps.en: Example: $1/(1+\sqrt2)=\sqrt2-1$. Check: $(1+\sqrt2)(\sqrt2-1)=1$.

say.en: Which sign change cancels the radical terms? Why is the new denominator nonzero?
say.zh: 改哪个符号可以消去根式项？新分母为什么不为零？

pitfalls.en: This radical conjugation is not complex conjugation: √2 is real. The rationality assumption is essential in the nonzero-denominator argument.
pitfalls.zh: 这不是复共轭，因为 √2 是实数。证明新分母非零时，有理数这一条件很重要。

title: Warm-up: representing 2 − i · 热身：同一复数的不同表示
source: 原题来源 / Question source: Linear Algebra tutorial ideas 2026, p. 2, Week 1, Warm-up · 2 − i 的不同表示. A1–A6 are local activity labels, NOT Problem Sheet 1 question numbers. 知识联系（非原题对应）：Q1.6：极坐标与方向；这里用的是复数示例，不是 Q1.6 原题。 Worked explanations, diagrams and checks are independently expanded tutor preparation.
questionEn: How many different ways can we represent the complex number $2-i$?
questionZh: 复数 $2-i$ 可以用多少种不同方式表示？

overview.en: This is an open-ended warm-up, not a request for a fixed number of answers. Connect algebraic form, a point in the Argand plane and polar form.
overview.zh: 这是开放式热身，并不要求给出固定数量的答案。把代数形式、复平面上的点和极形式联系起来即可。

prerequisites.en: $a+bi$ corresponds to $(a,b)$; $|a+bi|=\sqrt{a^2+b^2}$.
prerequisites.zh: $a+bi$ 对应 $(a,b)$；$|a+bi|=\sqrt{a^2+b^2}$。

prerequisites.en: An angle must match both coordinate signs, not only their ratio.
prerequisites.zh: 角度必须同时符合两个坐标的符号，不能只满足它们的比值。

strategy.en: Start with the representation everyone can access: read the real and imaginary parts and draw the point. Then ask for its distance from the origin and its direction.
strategy.zh: 从最容易开始的表示入手：读出实部、虚部并画点。再问到原点的距离以及方向。

strategy.en: Accept equivalent angles unless a particular interval is required. Invite explanations of how each representation encodes the same number.
strategy.zh: 若未指定辐角区间，应接受等价的角。让学生解释：不同表示如何表达同一个数。

steps.en: Rectangular form: $z=2+(-1)i$. The real part is $2$ and the imaginary part is $-1$.
Argand diagram: plot $(2,-1)$, two units right and one down. It is in the fourth quadrant.
steps.zh: 复平面：画点 $(2,-1)$，向右 2、向下 1，位于第四象限。

steps.en: The modulus is $r=\sqrt{2^2+(-1)^2}=\sqrt5$. Let $\alpha=\arctan(1/2)$, so one argument is $\theta=-\alpha$.
steps.zh: 模为 $r=\sqrt{2^2+(-1)^2}=\sqrt5$。令 $\alpha=\arctan(1/2)$，则一个辐角为 $\theta=-\alpha$。

steps.en: Polar form: $z=\sqrt5\bigl(\cos(-\alpha)+i\sin(-\alpha)\bigr)$. Since $\cos(-\alpha)=2/\sqrt5$ and $\sin(-\alpha)=-1/\sqrt5$, substitution gives exactly $2-i$.
steps.zh: 极形式：$z=\sqrt5\bigl(\cos(-\alpha)+i\sin(-\alpha)\bigr)$。因为 $\cos(-\alpha)=2/\sqrt5$、$\sin(-\alpha)=-1/\sqrt5$，代入恰好得到 $2-i$。

steps.en: If using $[0,2\pi)$, choose $\theta=2\pi-\alpha$. Numerically, $-\alpha\approx-0.463648$ radians and $2\pi-\alpha\approx5.819538$ radians.
steps.zh: 若采用 $[0,2\pi)$，就取 $\theta=2\pi-\alpha$。近似值分别为 $-\alpha\approx-0.463648$ 弧度、$2\pi-\alpha\approx5.819538$ 弧度。

say.en: Can you show the same number as a point, and then as a length and an angle? Which quadrant must it lie in?
say.zh: 能不能先把这个数表示成一个点，再表示成长度与角度？它一定在哪个象限？

pitfalls.en: The argument is not $-\pi/4$: that would have equal-magnitude real and imaginary parts. Here their magnitudes are $2$ and $1$.
pitfalls.zh: 辐角不是 $-\pi/4$；那个角的实部和虚部绝对值相等，而这里分别是 $2$ 和 $1$。

pitfalls.en: Do not insist that students know exponential notation before using the warm-up. The diagram and trigonometric polar form already meet the purpose.
pitfalls.zh: 不用把指数记法当成参与热身的门槛。图形与三角形式已经能够达到目的。

alternatives.en: If already taught, $z=\sqrt5e^{-i\alpha}$. More generally $\sqrt5e^{i(-\alpha+2\pi m)}$ represents the same number for any $m\in\mathbb Z$.
alternatives.zh: 如果已经学过，可以写 $z=\sqrt5e^{-i\alpha}$。更一般地，对任意 $m\in\mathbb Z$，$\sqrt5e^{i(-\alpha+2\pi m)}$ 都表示同一个数。

title: Vector calculations and a midpoint · 向量运算与中点
source: 原题来源 / Question source: Linear Algebra tutorial ideas 2026, p. 2, Week 1, Questions · 第 1 项：向量计算. A1–A6 are local activity labels, NOT Problem Sheet 1 question numbers. 知识联系（非原题对应）：Q1.2：向量、坐标与图示的基础；正式题没有这组 x、y 方程。 Worked explanations, diagrams and checks are independently expanded tutor preparation.
questionEn: Let $\mathbf u=\begin{pmatrix}4\\0\end{pmatrix}$, $\mathbf v=\begin{pmatrix}1\\2\end{pmatrix}$, $\mathbf w=\begin{pmatrix}1\\-2\end{pmatrix}$. Find $\mathbf x,\mathbf y\in\mathbb R^2$ where $\mathbf x=3\mathbf u-2(\mathbf v+\mathbf w)$ and $\mathbf w-\mathbf y=\mathbf y-\mathbf u$.
questionZh: 设 $\mathbf u=\begin{pmatrix}4\\0\end{pmatrix}$、$\mathbf v=\begin{pmatrix}1\\2\end{pmatrix}$、$\mathbf w=\begin{pmatrix}1\\-2\end{pmatrix}$。求 $\mathbf x,\mathbf y\in\mathbb R^2$，使 $\mathbf x=3\mathbf u-2(\mathbf v+\mathbf w)$ 且 $\mathbf w-\mathbf y=\mathbf y-\mathbf u$。

overview.en: The first calculation checks brackets and component arithmetic. The second checks rearrangement; its answer also has a midpoint interpretation.
overview.zh: 第一问检查括号与分量运算，第二问检查方程整理；第二问答案还有中点的几何意义。

prerequisites.en: Add and scale corresponding components. Adding the same vector to both sides preserves equality.
prerequisites.zh: 对对应分量做加法和数乘。在方程两边加同一个向量保持等式成立。

strategy.en: For x, calculate the bracket first: the vertical components cancel. For y, move both copies of y to one side before substituting coordinates.
strategy.zh: 求 x 时先算括号：竖直分量刚好抵消。求 y 时先把两个 y 集中到同一边，再代入坐标。

steps.en: $\mathbf v+\mathbf w=\begin{pmatrix}1+1\\2-2\end{pmatrix}=\begin{pmatrix}2\\0\end{pmatrix}$.
steps.zh: $\mathbf v+\mathbf w=\begin{pmatrix}1+1\\2-2\end{pmatrix}=\begin{pmatrix}2\\0\end{pmatrix}$。

steps.en: $\mathbf x=\begin{pmatrix}12\\0\end{pmatrix}-\begin{pmatrix}4\\0\end{pmatrix}=\boxed{\begin{pmatrix}8\\0\end{pmatrix}}$.
steps.zh: $\mathbf x=\begin{pmatrix}12\\0\end{pmatrix}-\begin{pmatrix}4\\0\end{pmatrix}=\boxed{\begin{pmatrix}8\\0\end{pmatrix}}$。

steps.en: Add $\mathbf y+\mathbf u$ to both sides of $\mathbf w-\mathbf y=\mathbf y-\mathbf u$: $\mathbf w+\mathbf u=2\mathbf y$. Therefore $\mathbf y=\frac12\begin{pmatrix}5\\-2\end{pmatrix}=\boxed{\begin{pmatrix}5/2\\-1\end{pmatrix}}$.
steps.zh: 在 $\mathbf w-\mathbf y=\mathbf y-\mathbf u$ 两边加上 $\mathbf y+\mathbf u$，得到 $\mathbf w+\mathbf u=2\mathbf y$。所以 $\mathbf y=\frac12\begin{pmatrix}5\\-2\end{pmatrix}=\boxed{\begin{pmatrix}5/2\\-1\end{pmatrix}}$。

steps.en: Check: $\mathbf w-\mathbf y=\begin{pmatrix}-3/2\\-1\end{pmatrix}=\mathbf y-\mathbf u$. Both sides are the same vector.
steps.zh: 检验：$\mathbf w-\mathbf y=\begin{pmatrix}-3/2\\-1\end{pmatrix}=\mathbf y-\mathbf u$。两边确实是相同的向量。

steps.en: The equation says the displacement from u to y equals the displacement from y to w. Therefore y lies halfway between their endpoints.
steps.zh: 原方程表示从 u 到 y 的位移，等于从 y 到 w 的位移，所以 y 的端点位于二者正中间。

say.en: What cancels inside the brackets? For the second part, can we collect the unknown vector before touching its coordinates?
say.zh: 括号里面什么会抵消？第二部分能不能先整理未知向量，再计算坐标？

pitfalls.en: $\mathbf w-\mathbf y=\mathbf y-\mathbf u$ gives $2\mathbf y=\mathbf w+\mathbf u$, not $\mathbf w-\mathbf u$.
pitfalls.zh: $\mathbf w-\mathbf y=\mathbf y-\mathbf u$ 整理后是 $2\mathbf y=\mathbf w+\mathbf u$，不是 $\mathbf w-\mathbf u$。

alternatives.en: Coordinate method: write $\mathbf y=(a,b)$. Then $1-a=a-4$ and $-2-b=b$, giving $a=5/2$, $b=-1$. This is equivalent to vector rearrangement.
alternatives.zh: 分量法：令 $\mathbf y=(a,b)$，则 $1-a=a-4$、$-2-b=b$，得到 $a=5/2$、$b=-1$。与向量整体移项完全等价。

title: Polar to Cartesian · 极坐标转直角坐标
source: 原题来源 / Question source: Linear Algebra tutorial ideas 2026, p. 2, Week 1, Questions · 第 2 项：λ = 5，θ = π/4. A1–A6 are local activity labels, NOT Problem Sheet 1 question numbers. 知识联系（非原题对应）：Q1.6：极坐标表示的入门计算；不是原题的证明要求。 Worked explanations, diagrams and checks are independently expanded tutor preparation.
questionEn: Find $\mathbf x\in\mathbb R^2$ such that $\mathbf x=\lambda\mathbf u(\theta)$ for $\lambda=5$ and $\theta=\pi/4$. Note that $\mathbf u(\theta)=\begin{pmatrix}\cos\theta\\\sin\theta\end{pmatrix}$.
questionZh: 取 $\lambda=5$、$\theta=\pi/4$，求满足 $\mathbf x=\lambda\mathbf u(\theta)$ 的 $\mathbf x\in\mathbb R^2$，其中 $\mathbf u(\theta)=\begin{pmatrix}\cos\theta\\\sin\theta\end{pmatrix}$。

overview.en: Multiply the unit direction vector by the required length. The equal positive coordinates are a useful check for a 45-degree direction.
overview.zh: 把单位方向向量乘以所需长度。45 度方向对应两个相等的正坐标，可以用来检验答案。

prerequisites.en: $\cos(\pi/4)=\sin(\pi/4)=\sqrt2/2$. Scalar multiplication acts on both coordinates.
prerequisites.zh: $\cos(\pi/4)=\sin(\pi/4)=\sqrt2/2$。数乘要作用在两个坐标上。

strategy.en: Find the direction first, then apply the length. Before calculating, predict first-quadrant coordinates of equal size.
strategy.zh: 先确定方向，再乘长度。计算前先预测：第一象限、两个坐标大小相等。

steps.en: $\mathbf u(\pi/4)=\begin{pmatrix}\sqrt2/2\\\sqrt2/2\end{pmatrix}$.
steps.zh: $\mathbf u(\pi/4)=\begin{pmatrix}\sqrt2/2\\\sqrt2/2\end{pmatrix}$。

steps.en: $\mathbf x=5\mathbf u(\pi/4)=\boxed{\begin{pmatrix}5\sqrt2/2\\5\sqrt2/2\end{pmatrix}}$.
steps.zh: $\mathbf x=5\mathbf u(\pi/4)=\boxed{\begin{pmatrix}5\sqrt2/2\\5\sqrt2/2\end{pmatrix}}$。

steps.en: Length check: $\|\mathbf x\|=\sqrt{25/2+25/2}=5$. Direction check: both components are positive and equal.
steps.zh: 长度检验：$\|\mathbf x\|=\sqrt{25/2+25/2}=5$。方向检验：两个分量为正且相等。

say.en: Is five the length or one of the coordinates? How can we check our answer has length five?
say.zh: 5 是长度，还是某一个坐标？怎么检查答案的长度确实为 5？

pitfalls.en: $(5,5)$ has length $5\sqrt2$, not $5$. Scaling a unit vector avoids that error.
pitfalls.zh: $(5,5)$ 的长度是 $5\sqrt2$，不是 $5$。从单位向量出发做数乘，可以避免这个错误。

title: Cartesian to polar on the axes · 坐标轴上的极坐标
source: 原题来源 / Question source: Linear Algebra tutorial ideas 2026, p. 2, Week 1, Questions · 第 3 项：(3,0) 与 (0,−3). A1–A6 are local activity labels, NOT Problem Sheet 1 question numbers. 知识联系（非原题对应）：Q1.6：方向角与极坐标；这里是坐标轴特例。 Worked explanations, diagrams and checks are independently expanded tutor preparation.
questionEn: Write $\begin{pmatrix}3\\0\end{pmatrix}$ in the form $\mathbf v=\lambda\mathbf u(\theta)$ where $\lambda>0$, $\theta\in[0,2\pi)$, and $\mathbf u(\theta)=\begin{pmatrix}\cos\theta\\\sin\theta\end{pmatrix}$. What about $\begin{pmatrix}0\\-3\end{pmatrix}$?
questionZh: 把 $\begin{pmatrix}3\\0\end{pmatrix}$ 写成 $\mathbf v=\lambda\mathbf u(\theta)$，其中 $\lambda>0$、$\theta\in[0,2\pi)$，$\mathbf u(\theta)=\begin{pmatrix}\cos\theta\\\sin\theta\end{pmatrix}$。那么 $\begin{pmatrix}0\\-3\end{pmatrix}$ 呢？

overview.en: Read each direction directly from the axes. The interval condition matters: a negative angle may point correctly but fail the requested form.
overview.zh: 直接从坐标轴读方向。区间要求很重要：负角度虽然方向可能正确，却不符合本题要求的形式。

prerequisites.en: With a positive radius, the radius equals the vector length. Angles start on the positive horizontal axis and turn anticlockwise.
prerequisites.zh: 半径为正时，它就是向量长度。角从水平正半轴出发，逆时针测量。

strategy.en: Sketch each arrow; compute its length; choose the angle in the specified half-open interval; substitute to check.
strategy.zh: 先画箭头，再求长度，接着在指定半开区间里选角，最后代回检验。

steps.en: For $(3,0)$, $\lambda=\sqrt{9}=3$. It points right, so $\theta=0$. Thus $\boxed{(3,0)=3\mathbf u(0)}$.
steps.zh: 对于 $(3,0)$，$\lambda=\sqrt9=3$。方向向右，所以 $\theta=0$。故 $\boxed{(3,0)=3\mathbf u(0)}$。

steps.en: For $(0,-3)$, $\lambda=3$. It points down, reached by an anticlockwise turn of $3\pi/2$. Thus $\boxed{(0,-3)=3\mathbf u(3\pi/2)}$.
steps.zh: 对于 $(0,-3)$，$\lambda=3$。方向向下，从正横轴逆时针转 $3\pi/2$ 到达。故 $\boxed{(0,-3)=3\mathbf u(3\pi/2)}$。

steps.en: $-\pi/2$ points down too, but is outside $[0,2\pi)$. Add $2\pi$ to obtain $3\pi/2$. Similarly $2\pi$ is excluded, so use $0$ for the first vector.
steps.zh: $-\pi/2$ 也指向下方，但不属于 $[0,2\pi)$，加上 $2\pi$ 就得到 $3\pi/2$。同理，$2\pi$ 被排除，第一问应使用 $0$。

say.en: Which way does the arrow point? Your angle is geometrically correct—but is it in the interval the question asks for?
say.zh: 箭头朝哪里？你的角方向虽然正确，但在题目要求的区间里吗？

pitfalls.en: $\lambda=-3$, $\theta=\pi/2$ produces $(0,-3)$ but violates $\lambda>0$.
pitfalls.zh: $\lambda=-3$、$\theta=\pi/2$ 虽然得到 $(0,-3)$，却违反 $\lambda>0$。

pitfalls.en: Do not attempt division by the horizontal coordinate for the vertical-axis case.
pitfalls.zh: 竖直轴上的点横坐标为零，不要试图通过除以横坐标来求角。

title: Complex fraction · 复数分式
source: 原题来源 / Question source: Linear Algebra tutorial ideas 2026, p. 2, Week 1, Questions · 第 4 项：复数分式. A1–A6 are local activity labels, NOT Problem Sheet 1 question numbers. 知识联系（非原题对应）：Q1.4：共轭、商与模的性质；这里练计算，正式题要求证明。 Worked explanations, diagrams and checks are independently expanded tutor preparation.
questionEn: Write $\displaystyle\frac{(3+2i)(3-2i)}{i+1}$ in the form $a+bi$ for $a,b\in\mathbb R$.
questionZh: 把 $\displaystyle\frac{(3+2i)(3-2i)}{i+1}$ 写成 $a+bi$，其中 $a,b\in\mathbb R$。

overview.en: Use the conjugate structure twice: first to simplify the numerator, then to remove the imaginary denominator.
overview.zh: 共轭结构用两次：先化简分子，再使分母变成实数。

prerequisites.en: $i^2=-1$ and $(a+bi)(a-bi)=a^2+b^2$. The denominator $1+i$ is nonzero.

strategy.en: Notice the numerator is a conjugate pair instead of expanding every term. Then ask what to multiply 1+i by to make it real.
strategy.zh: 注意到分子是一对共轭，不必机械展开全部项。接着思考：1+i 乘什么会变成实数？

steps.en: Therefore $\boxed{\frac{13}{2}-\frac{13}{2}i}$, with $a=13/2$ and $b=-13/2$.
Check: $(13/2-13i/2)(1+i)=13/2+13/2=13$. This recovers the simplified numerator.

say.en: What special structure do you notice in the numerator? Now, how can we make the denominator real without changing the fraction?
say.zh: 分子有什么特殊结构？接下来怎么在不改变分式值的前提下，让分母变成实数？

pitfalls.en: $(2i)^2=-4$, so the numerator is $13$, not $5$.
The conjugate of 1+i is 1−i, not −1+i.
pitfalls.zh: 1+i 的共轭是 1−i，不是 −1+i。

alternatives.en: Set the quotient equal to $a+bi$. Then $(a+bi)(1+i)=(a-b)+(a+b)i=13$, so $a-b=13$ and $a+b=0$. Solve to get $a=13/2$, $b=-13/2$.

title: Dot product and cosine · 点积与夹角余弦
scope: 课堂可选 · 有时间再做
source: 原题来源 / Question source: Linear Algebra tutorial ideas 2026, p. 3, Week 1, Questions · 第 5 项（跨页）：点积与夹角. A1–A6 are local activity labels, NOT Problem Sheet 1 question numbers. 知识联系（非原题对应）：Q1.6：点积与夹角关系；也联系 Q1.5 的正交，但本例不正交。 Worked explanations, diagrams and checks are independently expanded tutor preparation.
questionEn: Compute the dot product $\begin{pmatrix}1\\2\end{pmatrix}\cdot\begin{pmatrix}6\\-8\end{pmatrix}$ and hence determine the cosine of the angle between the vectors.
questionZh: 计算点积 $\begin{pmatrix}1\\2\end{pmatrix}\cdot\begin{pmatrix}6\\-8\end{pmatrix}$，并据此求两向量夹角的余弦。

overview.en: Calculate a scalar dot product and divide by the product of the two lengths. A negative result tells us the angle is obtuse.
overview.zh: 先求标量点积，再除以两个长度的乘积。答案为负，说明夹角是钝角。

prerequisites.en: $\mathbf a\cdot\mathbf b=a_1b_1+a_2b_2$ and $\cos\theta=(\mathbf a\cdot\mathbf b)/(\|\mathbf a\|\|\mathbf b\|)$ for nonzero vectors.
prerequisites.zh: $\mathbf a\cdot\mathbf b=a_1b_1+a_2b_2$；非零向量满足 $\cos\theta=(\mathbf a\cdot\mathbf b)/(\|\mathbf a\|\|\mathbf b\|)$。

strategy.en: Keep the three calculations separate: dot product, first length, second length. Then combine them. Ask for the sign of the angle relationship before any inverse trigonometry.
strategy.zh: 把点积、第一向量长度、第二向量长度分开计算，再合并。无需反三角函数，先根据正负判断夹角类型。

steps.en: $\mathbf a\cdot\mathbf b=1\cdot6+2\cdot(-8)=6-16=\boxed{-10}$.
steps.zh: $\mathbf a\cdot\mathbf b=1\cdot6+2\cdot(-8)=6-16=\boxed{-10}$。

steps.en: $\displaystyle\cos\theta=\frac{-10}{10\sqrt5}=\boxed{-\frac1{\sqrt5}}=-\frac{\sqrt5}{5}$. This is the requested exact answer.
steps.zh: $\displaystyle\cos\theta=\frac{-10}{10\sqrt5}=\boxed{-\frac1{\sqrt5}}=-\frac{\sqrt5}{5}$。这是题目要求的精确答案。

steps.en: Check: $-1<-1/\sqrt5<0$, so $\pi/2<\theta<\pi$. If desired for checking only, $\theta\approx116.565^\circ$.
steps.zh: 检验：$-1<-1/\sqrt5<0$，因此 $\pi/2<\theta<\pi$。若仅作数值核对，$\theta\approx116.565^\circ$。

say.en: We found a negative dot product. Does that mean the vectors make an acute or an obtuse angle? The question asks for the cosine, so where should we stop?
say.zh: 点积为负，夹角是锐角还是钝角？题目只问余弦，我们应该算到哪里就停？

pitfalls.en: $(-8)^2=64$, not $-64$. The length calculation and the signed dot product are different operations.
pitfalls.zh: $(-8)^2=64$，不是 $-64$。长度计算与保留正负号的点积计算是两种不同运算。

pitfalls.en: The denominator is the product of lengths, not their sum and not the product of their squares.
pitfalls.zh: 分母是两个长度的乘积，不是和，也不是平方后的乘积。

title: Official Q1.1 hand-in · 官方 Q1.1 提交作业（教师备课）
scope: 仅教师备课 · Week 1 不完整讲解
source: Official Problem Sheet 1, Q1.1; Week 1 tutorial guidance, pages 3–4. Hand-in due Wednesday 30 September 2026 at 12:00 noon, for tutor feedback and not graded. Do not go through in Week 1. Main solution follows the official tutor solution; rationale, checks, induction and alternative constructions are tutor expansions.
questionEn:
(a) Let $\mathbf u=\begin{pmatrix}1\\0\end{pmatrix}$ and $\mathbf v=\begin{pmatrix}1\\y\end{pmatrix}$ with $y\in\mathbb R$. Compute $\|\mathbf u\|$, $\|\mathbf v\|$ and $\|\mathbf u+\mathbf v\|$, and determine for which $y\in\mathbb R$ we have $\|\mathbf u+\mathbf v\|=\|\mathbf u\|+\|\mathbf v\|$. Sketch the vectors $\mathbf u$, $\mathbf v$ and $\mathbf u+\mathbf v$ in this case.

(b) Let $\mathbf v_1,\mathbf v_2,\ldots,\mathbf v_k\in\mathbb R^n$ be $k$ arbitrary vectors in $\mathbb R^n$. Use the triangle inequality to show that $\|\mathbf v_1+\mathbf v_2+\cdots+\mathbf v_k\|\le\|\mathbf v_1\|+\|\mathbf v_2\|+\cdots+\|\mathbf v_k\|$ and give an example of $k$ vectors for which there is equality.
questionZh:
(a) 设 $\mathbf u=\begin{pmatrix}1\\0\end{pmatrix}$、$\mathbf v=\begin{pmatrix}1\\y\end{pmatrix}$，其中 $y\in\mathbb R$。计算 $\|\mathbf u\|$、$\|\mathbf v\|$ 和 $\|\mathbf u+\mathbf v\|$，确定哪些 $y\in\mathbb R$ 满足 $\|\mathbf u+\mathbf v\|=\|\mathbf u\|+\|\mathbf v\|$，并在此情形下画出 $\mathbf u$、$\mathbf v$ 和 $\mathbf u+\mathbf v$。

(b) 设 $\mathbf v_1,\mathbf v_2,\ldots,\mathbf v_k\in\mathbb R^n$ 是 $k$ 个任意向量。利用三角不等式证明 $\|\mathbf v_1+\mathbf v_2+\cdots+\mathbf v_k\|\le\|\mathbf v_1\|+\|\mathbf v_2\|+\cdots+\|\mathbf v_k\|$，并给出一组使等号成立的 $k$ 个向量。

overview.en: Tutor-only preparation. The official tutorial guidance explicitly says this is the hand-in submitted in Week 2: do not go through it in the Week 1 tutorial; pointers on how to start are allowed. The solution below follows the official algebra and repeated triangle inequality, with our additional explanations, checks and alternative constructions. This is official Problem Sheet 1, Q1.1 (website reference C1), due Wednesday 30 September 2026 at 12:00 noon. It is for tutor feedback and is not graded; this is separate from the graded Numbas quiz. Staff-side solution visibility does not establish what a student account can see.
overview.zh: 仅教师备课。官方指导明确说明：这是 Week 2 提交的作业，不要在 Week 1 tutorial 中完整讲解；允许提示如何开始。以下沿用官方代数与重复使用三角不等式的解法，补充我们自己的解释、检验和其他例子。 对应官方 Problem Sheet 1 的 Q1.1（本网页索引 C1），截止时间为 2026 年 9 月 30 日周三中午 12:00。提交作业用于教师反馈、不计分，与计分的 Numbas 测验不同。教师端能查看答案，不代表已验证学生账号也能查看。

prerequisites.en: $\|(a,b)\|=\sqrt{a^2+b^2}$; compute the vector sum before its norm. The two-vector triangle inequality applies to any pair of vectors in $\mathbb R^n$.
prerequisites.zh: $\|(a,b)\|=\sqrt{a^2+b^2}$；必须先求和向量，再算它的范数。二向量三角不等式适用于 $\mathbb R^n$ 中任意两个向量。

prerequisites.en: Squaring an equation is reversible if both sides are nonnegative. Otherwise squaring can introduce false candidates, so a substitution check is essential.
prerequisites.zh: 等式两边都非负时，平方是可逆的；否则平方可能引入伪解，所以最后代回检验很重要。

strategy.en: Permissible Week 1 hint for (a): “Start by writing down the three lengths from their coordinates. What equation would express the requested equality?” Stop before solving that equation or giving y.
strategy.zh: Week 1 可给的 (a) 提示：“先根据坐标写出三个长度。需要取等号时，会得到什么方程？”提示到这里即可，不要继续解方程或告诉学生 y。

strategy.en: Permissible Week 1 hint for (b): “The triangle inequality handles two vectors. Can you regard part of this long sum as a single vector?” Ask students to show each application clearly; do not give the complete chain or an equality example in the tutorial.
strategy.zh: Week 1 可给的 (b) 提示：“三角不等式处理两个向量。能否把这一长串和的一部分看成一个向量？”提醒写清每次使用的对象，不在 tutorial 给出完整链条或取等号例子。

strategy.en: For your own preparation: (a) isolate a square root after one squaring, then check reversibility. For (b), successively split one vector off; construct equality by avoiding any change of direction or cancellation.
strategy.zh: 教师自己备课时：(a) 平方一次后，把一个根式单独留下，并核对步骤是否可逆；(b) 每次从和里拆出一个向量。构造等号例子时，让方向不变、没有抵消。

steps.en: (a), lengths: $\|\mathbf u\|=1$, $\|\mathbf v\|=\sqrt{1+y^2}$, and $\mathbf u+\mathbf v=(2,y)$, so $\|\mathbf u+\mathbf v\|=\sqrt{4+y^2}$.
steps.zh: (a)，先求长度：$\|\mathbf u\|=1$，$\|\mathbf v\|=\sqrt{1+y^2}$；而 $\mathbf u+\mathbf v=(2,y)$，所以 $\|\mathbf u+\mathbf v\|=\sqrt{4+y^2}$。

steps.en: The required equation is $\sqrt{4+y^2}=1+\sqrt{1+y^2}$. Both sides are positive for every real $y$, so squaring is an equivalence, not merely an implication.
steps.zh: 要求满足的方程为 $\sqrt{4+y^2}=1+\sqrt{1+y^2}$。对任意实数 $y$，两边都为正，因此平方是等价变形，而不只是单向推导。

steps.en: Square and expand the whole right-hand side: $4+y^2=1+2\sqrt{1+y^2}+(1+y^2)=2+y^2+2\sqrt{1+y^2}$. Cancel $y^2$ and rearrange to get $\sqrt{1+y^2}=1$.
steps.zh: 平方时必须展开右边整个和：$4+y^2=1+2\sqrt{1+y^2}+(1+y^2)=2+y^2+2\sqrt{1+y^2}$。消去 $y^2$ 并整理，得到 $\sqrt{1+y^2}=1$。

steps.en: Both sides are again nonnegative, so square once more: $1+y^2=1$, hence $y^2=0$ and $\boxed{y=0}$. Substitution verifies $\sqrt4=1+\sqrt1=2$, proving necessity and sufficiency.
steps.zh: 两边仍然非负，再平方得 $1+y^2=1$，因此 $y^2=0$，即 $\boxed{y=0}$。代回原式有 $\sqrt4=1+\sqrt1=2$，所以既证明了必要性，也验证了充分性。

steps.en: Sketch at $y=0$: $\mathbf u=\mathbf v=(1,0)$ and $\mathbf u+\mathbf v=(2,0)$. Draw two labelled, overlapping arrows from $(0,0)$ to $(1,0)$ and a longer arrow to $(2,0)$. A second head-to-tail picture places a translated copy of $\mathbf v$ from $(1,0)$ to $(2,0)$.
steps.zh: $y=0$ 时作图：$\mathbf u=\mathbf v=(1,0)$，$\mathbf u+\mathbf v=(2,0)$。从 $(0,0)$ 向 $(1,0)$ 画重叠的箭头并标出 u、v，再向 $(2,0)$ 画较长的和向量。另画首尾相接图时，把 v 平移到从 $(1,0)$ 指向 $(2,0)$。

steps.en: (b), take a positive integer $k$. For $k=1$ the statement is equality. For $k\ge2$, apply the triangle inequality to $\mathbf v_1$ and $\mathbf v_2+\cdots+\mathbf v_k$: $\|\mathbf v_1+\cdots+\mathbf v_k\|\le\|\mathbf v_1\|+\|\mathbf v_2+\cdots+\mathbf v_k\|$.
steps.zh: (b)，设 $k$ 是正整数。$k=1$ 时结论直接取等号。$k\ge2$ 时，先把 $\mathbf v_1$ 与 $\mathbf v_2+\cdots+\mathbf v_k$ 当作两个向量使用三角不等式：$\|\mathbf v_1+\cdots+\mathbf v_k\|\le\|\mathbf v_1\|+\|\mathbf v_2+\cdots+\mathbf v_k\|$。

steps.en: Now split the remaining sum again. For example, if $k\ge3$, $\|\mathbf v_2+\cdots+\mathbf v_k\|\le\|\mathbf v_2\|+\|\mathbf v_3+\cdots+\mathbf v_k\|$. Substitute this upper bound into the previous line.
steps.zh: 继续把剩下的和拆开。例如 $k\ge3$ 时，$\|\mathbf v_2+\cdots+\mathbf v_k\|\le\|\mathbf v_2\|+\|\mathbf v_3+\cdots+\mathbf v_k\|$。再把这个上界代回上一行。

steps.en: After $k-1$ applications, no unsplit sum remains: $\boxed{\|\mathbf v_1+\cdots+\mathbf v_k\|\le\sum_{j=1}^{k}\|\mathbf v_j\|}$. Each step bounds a two-vector sum; we have not assumed the very multi-vector result we are proving.
steps.zh: 共使用 $k-1$ 次后，不再有需要拆分的和，得到 $\boxed{\|\mathbf v_1+\cdots+\mathbf v_k\|\le\sum_{j=1}^{k}\|\mathbf v_j\|}$。每一步用的都是二向量版本，不能把要证明的多向量版本当作已知直接引用。

steps.en: Official equality example: choose any fixed $\mathbf q\in\mathbb R^n$ and set every $\mathbf v_j=\mathbf q$. Then the left side is $\|k\mathbf q\|=k\|\mathbf q\|$, exactly the sum of the $k$ norms on the right. This includes $\mathbf q=\mathbf0$.
steps.zh: 官方给出的等号例子：任选固定的 $\mathbf q\in\mathbb R^n$，令每个 $\mathbf v_j=\mathbf q$。左边为 $\|k\mathbf q\|=k\|\mathbf q\|$，恰好等于右边 $k$ 个范数的和。也允许 $\mathbf q=\mathbf0$。

steps.en: Source note: the official solution’s opening line for (b) writes v₁,…,vₙ while describing k vectors. We use v₁,…,vₖ consistently, matching the question and its inequality; n remains the dimension, not the number of vectors.
steps.zh: 原文校勘：官方 (b) 解答首行写成 v₁,…,vₙ，同时又说有 k 个向量。这里统一写为 v₁,…,vₖ，与题目和不等式一致；n 是维数，不是向量个数。

say.en: For today, I can help you start: write the lengths from the coordinates, and think about applying the triangle inequality to two grouped vectors. Leave the complete argument for your own hand-in, and explain each step in full sentences.
say.zh: 今天我可以帮助你起步：由坐标写出长度，并考虑怎样把和分成两个向量来使用三角不等式。完整推理留给你自己的提交作业，每一步用完整句子解释清楚。

pitfalls.en: Do not write $(1+\sqrt{1+y^2})^2=1+(1+y^2)$; the cross term $2\sqrt{1+y^2}$ is essential.
Do not claim equality is possible only when all vectors are equal. That is one convenient example, not a necessary condition.
pitfalls.zh: 不能说只有所有向量相等才能取等号。那只是一个方便的例子，不是必要条件。

pitfalls.en: Collinearity alone is not sufficient: nonzero vectors in opposite directions can cancel. Construct examples with nonnegative multiples of one fixed vector.
pitfalls.zh: 仅仅共线不够，反向非零向量会抵消。构造时可使用同一固定向量的非负倍数。

pitfalls.en: This complete answer is visible on this public tutor-preparation page. “Tutor-only” is a teaching-use label, not access control. Do not share or project this solution to students in the Week 1 tutorial.
pitfalls.zh: 完整答案可以在这个公开备课页面看到。“仅教师备课”是用途标签，不是访问权限控制。Week 1 tutorial 不要向学生分享或投影这份完整解答。

alternatives.en: Induction proof: the $k=1$ case is immediate. Assume $\|\sum_{j=1}^{m}\mathbf v_j\|\le\sum_{j=1}^{m}\|\mathbf v_j\|$. Then $\|\sum_{j=1}^{m+1}\mathbf v_j\|\le\|\sum_{j=1}^{m}\mathbf v_j\|+\|\mathbf v_{m+1}\|\le\sum_{j=1}^{m+1}\|\mathbf v_j\|$. This proves the result for every positive integer k.
alternatives.zh: 归纳法：$k=1$ 直接成立。假设 $\|\sum_{j=1}^{m}\mathbf v_j\|\le\sum_{j=1}^{m}\|\mathbf v_j\|$，则 $\|\sum_{j=1}^{m+1}\mathbf v_j\|\le\|\sum_{j=1}^{m}\mathbf v_j\|+\|\mathbf v_{m+1}\|\le\sum_{j=1}^{m+1}\|\mathbf v_j\|$。因此对所有正整数 k 成立。

alternatives.en: Nonunique equality construction: choose any $\mathbf q$ and any real coefficients $t_j\ge0$, and set $\mathbf v_j=t_j\mathbf q$. Then $\|\sum_j\mathbf v_j\|=(\sum_j t_j)\|\mathbf q\|=\sum_j\|\mathbf v_j\|$. Lengths may differ, and some vectors may be zero.
alternatives.zh: 非唯一的等号构造：任选 $\mathbf q$ 和非负实数 $t_j\ge0$，令 $\mathbf v_j=t_j\mathbf q$。则 $\|\sum_j\mathbf v_j\|=(\sum_j t_j)\|\mathbf q\|=\sum_j\|\mathbf v_j\|$。各向量长度可以不同，其中一些也可以为零。

alternatives.en: Concrete example for arbitrary k and n≥1: let $\mathbf e_1=(1,0,\ldots,0)$ and $\mathbf v_j=j\mathbf e_1$. Both sides equal $1+2+\cdots+k=k(k+1)/2$. We choose this because every arrow points along the same positive axis, so no length is lost through turning or cancellation.
alternatives.zh: 对任意 k 和 n≥1 的具体例子：令 $\mathbf e_1=(1,0,\ldots,0)$、$\mathbf v_j=j\mathbf e_1$。两边都等于 $1+2+\cdots+k=k(k+1)/2$。这样构造，是因为所有箭头都朝同一条正半轴，没有转弯或抵消带来的长度损失。

alternatives.en: Geometric check for (a): both vectors have first component 1. Equality requires the same direction. If $(1,y)=t(1,0)$ with $t\ge0$, the first component forces $t=1$ and the second forces $y=0$. This checks, rather than replaces, the requested norm computation.
alternatives.zh: (a) 的几何检验：两个向量的第一分量都为 1，等号要求同向。若 $(1,y)=t(1,0)$ 且 $t\ge0$，第一分量迫使 $t=1$，第二分量迫使 $y=0$。这是对结果的检验，不能取代题目要求的范数计算。

title: Q1.2 · Sketching vectors and finding lengths · 向量图示与长度
source: Linear Algebra 2026 · Problem Sheet 1 · Q1.2；题意据课程题单核对，以下为独立展开解答，并非官方答案逐字引用。
questionEn: Sketch the following vectors in $\mathbb R^2$ and calculate their norms: $(2,5)$, $(-2,5)$, $(0,2)$, $(0,-2)$, $(-1,-5)$ and $(0,0)$.

overview.en: A coordinate pair tells us where the arrow ends; the norm tells us its nonnegative length. Direction changes need not change length.
overview.zh: 坐标决定箭头终点，范数表示非负长度；方向改变不一定改变长度。

prerequisites.en: For $v=(x,y)$, $\|v\|=\sqrt{x^2+y^2}$. Draw the arrow from $(0,0)$ to $(x,y)$.

strategy.en: Use the same scale on both axes. Read the signs to choose the quadrant, then use Pythagoras for the length.
strategy.zh: 两条坐标轴使用相同比例。先根据符号判断象限，再用勾股定理求长度。

steps.en: $(2,5)$: move 2 right and 5 up; the endpoint is in quadrant I. $\|(2,5)\|=\sqrt{4+25}=\sqrt{29}$.
steps.zh: $(2,5)$：向右 2、向上 5，终点在第一象限。长度为 $\sqrt{4+25}=\sqrt{29}$。

steps.en: $(-2,5)$: move 2 left and 5 up; quadrant II. Its norm is also $\sqrt{29}$, since squaring removes the sign of the horizontal component.
steps.zh: $(-2,5)$：向左 2、向上 5，终点在第二象限。长度仍是 $\sqrt{29}$，因为横坐标平方后符号消失。

steps.en: $(0,2)$: an upward arrow on the vertical axis, of length $2$. $(0,-2)$: a downward arrow on that axis, also of length $2$.
$(-1,-5)$: move 1 left and 5 down; quadrant III. Its norm is $\sqrt{1+25}=\sqrt{26}$.
steps.zh: $(-1,-5)$：向左 1、向下 5，终点在第三象限。长度为 $\sqrt{1+25}=\sqrt{26}$。

steps.en: $(0,0)$ is the zero vector, with norm $0$. Mark the origin; there is no nonzero-length arrow and no defined direction.
steps.zh: $(0,0)$ 是零向量，长度为 $0$。在原点作标记即可；没有非零长度的箭头，也没有定义好的方向。

steps.en: Final lengths, in order: $\sqrt{29},\sqrt{29},2,2,\sqrt{26},0$. Check the sketch: reflecting an arrow across an axis preserves its length.
steps.zh: 按题目顺序，答案为 $\sqrt{29},\sqrt{29},2,2,\sqrt{26},0$。图形核查：关于坐标轴反射不改变箭头长度。

say.en: Which two arrows have the same length but opposite directions? Does a negative coordinate make a length negative?
say.zh: 哪两个箭头长度相同但方向相反？坐标为负是否意味着长度为负？

pitfalls.en: $\sqrt{x^2+y^2}$ is not $x+y$ or $|x|+|y|$. Do not assign the zero vector an angle.
pitfalls.zh: $\sqrt{x^2+y^2}$ 不等于 $x+y$ 或 $|x|+|y|$。不要给零向量指定唯一方向角。

title: Q1.3 · Parallelogram and polarisation identities · 平行四边形与极化恒等式
source: Linear Algebra 2026 · Problem Sheet 1 · Q1.3；题意据课程题单核对，以下为独立展开解答，并非官方答案逐字引用。
questionEn: Using $\|v\|^2=v\cdot v$, prove for real Euclidean vectors $v,w$: (a) $\|v-w\|^2+\|v+w\|^2=2\|v\|^2+2\|w\|^2$; (b) $v\cdot w=(\|v+w\|^2-\|v-w\|^2)/4$.

overview.en: The same two expansions solve both parts: adding cancels the cross terms; subtracting isolates them.
overview.zh: 同样的两个展开式解决两问：相加消去交叉项，相减留下交叉项。

prerequisites.en: The real dot product is bilinear and symmetric: $v\cdot w=w\cdot v$.
prerequisites.zh: 实数点积具有双线性和对称性：$v\cdot w=w\cdot v$。

strategy.en: Replace every squared norm by a self-dot-product before expanding. This makes every use of algebra explicit.
strategy.zh: 先把范数平方改写为向量与自己的点积，再展开，避免把向量当普通数字直接平方。

steps.en: $\|v+w\|^2=(v+w)\cdot(v+w)=v\cdot v+v\cdot w+w\cdot v+w\cdot w=\|v\|^2+2v\cdot w+\|w\|^2$.
steps.zh: $\|v+w\|^2=(v+w)\cdot(v+w)=v\cdot v+v\cdot w+w\cdot v+w\cdot w=\|v\|^2+2v\cdot w+\|w\|^2$。

steps.en: Similarly, $\|v-w\|^2=\|v\|^2-2v\cdot w+\|w\|^2$.
(a) Add the two equalities: the $+2v\cdot w$ and $-2v\cdot w$ cancel. The result is $2\|v\|^2+2\|w\|^2$.
steps.zh: (a) 两式相加，$+2v\cdot w$ 与 $-2v\cdot w$ 抵消，得到 $2\|v\|^2+2\|w\|^2$。

steps.en: Geometric interpretation: $v,w$ are adjacent sides of a parallelogram and $v+w,v-w$ are its diagonal vectors. The sum of squared diagonal lengths equals the sum of squared lengths of all four sides.
steps.zh: 几何解释：$v,w$ 是平行四边形的邻边，$v+w,v-w$ 是两条对角线对应的向量。两条对角线长度的平方和等于四条边长度的平方和。

steps.en: (b) Subtract the minus expansion from the plus expansion: $\|v+w\|^2-\|v-w\|^2=4v\cdot w$. Divide by $4$.
steps.zh: (b) 用加号展开式减去减号展开式，得 $\|v+w\|^2-\|v-w\|^2=4v\cdot w$，再除以 $4$。

say.en: If we add these expansions, what disappears? If we subtract them, what survives?
say.zh: 两式相加时什么消失？相减时什么留下来？

pitfalls.en: The cross term is $2v\cdot w$, not $v\cdot w$. The minus expansion has a positive $\|w\|^2$.
pitfalls.zh: 交叉项是 $2v\cdot w$，不是 $v\cdot w$。减号展开中 $\|w\|^2$ 仍为正号。

title: Q1.4 · Conjugates and complex modulus · 共轭与复数模
source: Linear Algebra 2026 · Problem Sheet 1 · Q1.4；题意据课程题单核对，以下为独立展开解答，并非官方答案逐字引用。
questionEn: For complex numbers $z,z_1,z_2$, prove: (a) $\overline{z_1+z_2}=\bar z_1+\bar z_2$; (b) $\overline{z_1z_2}=\bar z_1\bar z_2$; (c) $\overline{\bar z}=z$; (d) $\overline{z_1/z_2}=\bar z_1/\bar z_2$ when $z_2\ne0$; (e) $|z_1z_2|=|z_1||z_2|$; (f) $|z_1+z_2|\le |z_1|+|z_2|$.
questionZh: 对复数 $z,z_1,z_2$，证明：(a) $\overline{z_1+z_2}=\bar z_1+\bar z_2$；(b) $\overline{z_1z_2}=\bar z_1\bar z_2$；(c) $\overline{\bar z}=z$；(d) 当 $z_2\ne0$ 时，$\overline{z_1/z_2}=\bar z_1/\bar z_2$；(e) $|z_1z_2|=|z_1||z_2|$；(f) $|z_1+z_2|\le |z_1|+|z_2|$。

overview.en: Prove elementary conjugation rules in Cartesian form, then reuse them to prove modulus statements without circular reasoning.
overview.zh: 先用直角坐标证明共轭的基本规则，再利用这些规则证明模的性质，避免循环论证。

prerequisites.en: If $z=a+ib$ with real $a,b$, then $\bar z=a-ib$ and $|z|=\sqrt{a^2+b^2}$, so $z\bar z=|z|^2$.
prerequisites.zh: 若 $z=a+ib$ 且 $a,b$ 为实数，则 $\bar z=a-ib$、$|z|=\sqrt{a^2+b^2}$，因此 $z\bar z=|z|^2$。

prerequisites.en: For any complex $u$, $\operatorname{Re}u\le |\operatorname{Re}u|\le |u|$, since $|u|^2=(\operatorname{Re}u)^2+(\operatorname{Im}u)^2$.
prerequisites.zh: 对任意复数 $u$，$\operatorname{Re}u\le|\operatorname{Re}u|\le|u|$，因为 $|u|^2=(\operatorname{Re}u)^2+(\operatorname{Im}u)^2$。

strategy.en: Write two generic complex numbers once. For the triangle inequality, compare squares: expanding the square of the modulus creates a real cross term that can be bounded.
strategy.zh: 先统一写两个一般复数。三角不等式则比较平方：模平方展开后出现实数交叉项，便于估计。

steps.en: Let $z_1=a+ib$, $z_2=c+id$, with $a,b,c,d\in\mathbb R$. (a) $\overline{z_1+z_2}=(a+c)-i(b+d)=(a-ib)+(c-id)$.
steps.zh: 令 $z_1=a+ib$、$z_2=c+id$，其中四个分量为实数。(a) $\overline{z_1+z_2}=(a+c)-i(b+d)=(a-ib)+(c-id)$。

steps.en: (b) $z_1z_2=(ac-bd)+i(ad+bc)$, so $\overline{z_1z_2}=(ac-bd)-i(ad+bc)$. Direct multiplication gives $(a-ib)(c-id)$ equal to the same expression.
steps.zh: (b) $z_1z_2=(ac-bd)+i(ad+bc)$，故共轭为 $(ac-bd)-i(ad+bc)$。直接展开 $(a-ib)(c-id)$ 得到同一结果。

steps.en: (c) If $z=a+ib$, then $\overline{\bar z}=\overline{a-ib}=a+ib=z$. Also, $|\bar z|=|z|$.
steps.zh: (c) 若 $z=a+ib$，则 $\overline{\bar z}=\overline{a-ib}=a+ib=z$。同时 $|\bar z|=|z|$。

steps.en: (d) Assume $z_2\ne0$. Then $\bar z_2\ne0$ by (c). Set $q=z_1/z_2$, so $qz_2=z_1$. Conjugating and using (b) gives $\bar q\bar z_2=\bar z_1$. Divide by the nonzero $\bar z_2$ to obtain the claim.
steps.zh: (d) 假设 $z_2\ne0$。由 (c) 可知 $\bar z_2\ne0$。令 $q=z_1/z_2$，则 $qz_2=z_1$。两边取共轭并用 (b)，得到 $\bar q\bar z_2=\bar z_1$。除以非零的 $\bar z_2$ 即得结论。

steps.en: (e) $|z_1z_2|^2=(z_1z_2)\overline{z_1z_2}=z_1\bar z_1z_2\bar z_2=|z_1|^2|z_2|^2$. Both $|z_1z_2|$ and $|z_1||z_2|$ are nonnegative, so taking square roots gives $|z_1z_2|=|z_1||z_2|$.
(f) Expand: $|z_1+z_2|^2=|z_1|^2+|z_2|^2+z_1\bar z_2+\bar z_1z_2=|z_1|^2+|z_2|^2+2\operatorname{Re}(z_1\bar z_2)$. The cross terms are conjugates.
steps.zh: (f) 展开：$|z_1+z_2|^2=|z_1|^2+|z_2|^2+z_1\bar z_2+\bar z_1z_2=|z_1|^2+|z_2|^2+2\operatorname{Re}(z_1\bar z_2)$。两个交叉项互为共轭。

steps.en: By the prerequisite bound and (e), $\operatorname{Re}(z_1\bar z_2)\le |z_1\bar z_2|=|z_1||z_2|$. Therefore $|z_1+z_2|^2\le(|z_1|+|z_2|)^2$. Take nonnegative square roots.
steps.zh: 用前提知识中的估计和 (e)，$\operatorname{Re}(z_1\bar z_2)\le|z_1\bar z_2|=|z_1||z_2|$。因此 $|z_1+z_2|^2\le(|z_1|+|z_2|)^2$，取非负平方根即可。

steps.en: Optional equality check: equality in (f) holds when one number is zero or the two nonzero numbers point in the same direction, equivalently $z_1\bar z_2$ is a nonnegative real number.
steps.zh: 可选等号检查：(f) 在某个复数为零，或两个非零复数方向相同时取等号；等价地，$z_1\bar z_2$ 为非负实数。

say.en: For each step, which previously proved fact are we using? Why is taking a square root safe here?
say.zh: 每一步用了哪个已经证明的性质？这里为什么可以放心开平方？

pitfalls.en: Conjugation changes the sign of the imaginary part, not the whole number. Quotients require a nonzero denominator. Do not assume the triangle inequality in its own proof.
pitfalls.zh: 共轭只改变虚部符号，不是把整个复数变负。商必须要求分母非零。不能在三角不等式证明里预先假设它成立。

title: Q1.5 · Orthogonality and Pythagoras · 正交与勾股关系
source: Linear Algebra 2026 · Problem Sheet 1 · Q1.5；题意据课程题单核对，以下为独立展开解答，并非官方答案逐字引用。
questionEn: For real Euclidean vectors $x,y$, prove $x\cdot y=0$ if and only if $\|x+y\|^2=\|x\|^2+\|y\|^2$.
questionZh: 对实欧氏向量 $x,y$，证明 $x\cdot y=0$ 当且仅当 $\|x+y\|^2=\|x\|^2+\|y\|^2$。

overview.en: Orthogonality is exactly the condition that removes the cross term in the squared length of a sum.
overview.zh: 正交条件恰好让向量和的长度平方中的交叉项消失。

prerequisites.en: $\|x+y\|^2=\|x\|^2+2x\cdot y+\|y\|^2$. Orthogonal means $x\cdot y=0$, including cases involving the zero vector.
prerequisites.zh: $\|x+y\|^2=\|x\|^2+2x\cdot y+\|y\|^2$。正交的代数定义是 $x\cdot y=0$，也包含某个向量为零的情形。

strategy.en: An “if and only if” requires two directions. Use one identity, but explain how it gives each direction.
strategy.zh: “当且仅当”要证明两个方向。可以重复使用同一个恒等式，但要分别说清推导。

steps.en: Forward: suppose $x\cdot y=0$. Substitute into the expansion to obtain $\|x+y\|^2=\|x\|^2+\|y\|^2$.
steps.zh: 正向：假设 $x\cdot y=0$，代入展开式立即得 $\|x+y\|^2=\|x\|^2+\|y\|^2$。

steps.en: Reverse: suppose the squared-norm equality holds. Subtract it from the expansion; this gives $2x\cdot y=0$, hence $x\cdot y=0$.
steps.zh: 反向：假设题中范数平方等式成立。与展开式相减，得到 $2x\cdot y=0$，所以 $x\cdot y=0$。

steps.en: For nonzero vectors this is the familiar right-angle condition. If one is zero, the algebra still works, but the angle of the zero vector is undefined.
steps.zh: 对非零向量，这就是熟悉的直角条件。若某个向量为零，代数结论仍成立，但零向量没有定义好的夹角。

say.en: What extra term appears if the vectors are not perpendicular? Now prove the statement backwards.
say.zh: 如果向量不垂直，会多出哪一项？现在再反过来证明一次。

pitfalls.en: Proving only the forward implication is incomplete. Orthogonality does not mean either vector must be zero.
pitfalls.zh: 只证明正向不完整。正交也不意味着某个向量必须为零。

title: Q1.6 · Dot products and angles · 点积与夹角
source: Linear Algebra 2026 · Problem Sheet 1 · Q1.6；题意据课程题单核对，以下为独立展开解答，并非官方答案逐字引用。 本页题目为题意改述，含教学澄清（较小夹角、零向量或角度变换），不是官方逐字题面；原题措辞以学校题单为准。
questionEn: Let $v,w\in\mathbb R^2$. (a) Write them in polar form and sketch how to find the angle between them. (b) Express $v\cdot w$ using polar coordinates and $\cos\phi\cos\theta+\sin\phi\sin\theta=\cos(\phi-\theta)$. State the smaller angle in $[0,\pi]$ when both vectors are nonzero.
questionZh: 设 $v,w\in\mathbb R^2$。(a) 写成极坐标形式，并画图说明如何找到夹角。(b) 利用极坐标和 $\cos\phi\cos\theta+\sin\phi\sin\theta=\cos(\phi-\theta)$ 表示点积。两向量非零时，明确取 $[0,\pi]$ 内的较小夹角。

overview.en: Polar coordinates separate length from direction. The dot product combines the two lengths with the cosine of their relative angle.
overview.zh: 极坐标把长度与方向分开；点积等于两长度之积再乘相对夹角的余弦。

prerequisites.en: A nonzero planar vector has form $r(\cos\phi,\sin\phi)$ with $r>0$ and direction $\phi$ defined modulo $2\pi$.
prerequisites.zh: 非零平面向量可写为 $r(\cos\phi,\sin\phi)$，其中 $r>0$，方向角 $\phi$ 只在模 $2\pi$ 意义下确定。

strategy.en: Draw both arrows from the origin, mark each direction angle from the positive horizontal axis, and then compare the rays rather than blindly subtracting principal-angle values.
strategy.zh: 把两个箭头都从原点画出，分别从横轴正向标方向角；最后比较两条射线，而不是机械地把两个主值相减当答案。

steps.en: (a) For nonzero vectors, write $v=r(\cos\phi,\sin\phi)$ and $w=s(\cos\theta,\sin\theta)$, with $r=\|v\|$, $s=\|w\|$. Mark the rays at angles $\phi$ and $\theta$.
steps.zh: (a) 非零时，写 $v=r(\cos\phi,\sin\phi)$、$w=s(\cos\theta,\sin\theta)$，其中 $r=\|v\|$、$s=\|w\|$。在图上标出方向角为 $\phi$ 和 $\theta$ 的两条射线。

steps.en: Reduce $\phi-\theta$ modulo $2\pi$ to $\delta\in[0,2\pi)$. The smaller angle is $\alpha=\min(\delta,2\pi-\delta)\in[0,\pi]$. Equivalently, $\alpha=\arccos(\cos(\phi-\theta))$.
steps.zh: 把 $\phi-\theta$ 模 $2\pi$ 化为 $\delta\in[0,2\pi)$，则较小夹角为 $\alpha=\min(\delta,2\pi-\delta)\in[0,\pi]$。也可写成 $\alpha=\arccos(\cos(\phi-\theta))$。

steps.en: (b) Multiply corresponding coordinates: $v\cdot w=rs\cos\phi\cos\theta+rs\sin\phi\sin\theta=rs\cos(\phi-\theta)$. Since $\cos\alpha=\cos(\phi-\theta)$, this is $\|v\|\|w\|\cos\alpha$.
steps.zh: (b) 对应坐标相乘再相加：$v\cdot w=rs\cos\phi\cos\theta+rs\sin\phi\sin\theta=rs\cos(\phi-\theta)$。因 $\cos\alpha=\cos(\phi-\theta)$，所以等于 $\|v\|\|w\|\cos\alpha$。

steps.en: Hence $\alpha=\arccos((v\cdot w)/(\|v\|\|w\|))$ for nonzero vectors. Same direction gives a positive maximum; perpendicular gives zero; opposite directions give a negative minimum.
steps.zh: 所以非零时 $\alpha=\arccos((v\cdot w)/(\|v\|\|w\|))$。同向时点积取得正的最大值，垂直时为零，反向时取得负的最小值。

steps.en: If $v=0$ or $w=0$, the dot product is $0$ but the geometric angle is undefined. A zero vector can be written as $0(\cos\phi,\sin\phi)$ for any $\phi$; that does not give it a unique direction.
steps.zh: 若 $v=0$ 或 $w=0$，点积为 $0$，但几何夹角没有定义。零向量虽可用任意 $\phi$ 写为 $0(\cos\phi,\sin\phi)$，却不意味着它有唯一方向。

say.en: The dot product is a number, not an angle. What must we divide by before applying inverse cosine?
say.zh: 点积是一个数，不是夹角。使用反余弦前，我们要先除以什么？

pitfalls.en: $|\phi-\theta|$ can exceed $\pi$ and then is not the smaller angle. Never divide by the norm of a zero vector.
pitfalls.zh: $|\phi-\theta|$ 可能大于 $\pi$，这时不是较小夹角。绝不可除以零向量的范数。

title: Q1.7 · Triple-angle identities · 三倍角公式
source: Linear Algebra 2026 · Problem Sheet 1 · Q1.7；题意据课程题单核对，以下为独立展开解答，并非官方答案逐字引用。
questionEn: Use de Moivre’s formula to derive $\cos(3\phi)=4\cos^3\phi-3\cos\phi$ and $\sin(3\phi)=-4\sin^3\phi+3\sin\phi$.
questionZh: 利用棣莫弗公式推导 $\cos(3\phi)=4\cos^3\phi-3\cos\phi$ 和 $\sin(3\phi)=-4\sin^3\phi+3\sin\phi$。

overview.en: Expand one complex cube and equate real and imaginary parts. Then eliminate the unwanted squared trigonometric function.
overview.zh: 展开一个复数的三次方，再分别比较实部和虚部；最后用平方和等于一消去另一种三角函数。

prerequisites.en: $(\cos\phi+i\sin\phi)^3=\cos(3\phi)+i\sin(3\phi)$; $i^2=-1$, $i^3=-i$; $\cos^2\phi+\sin^2\phi=1$.
prerequisites.zh: $(\cos\phi+i\sin\phi)^3=\cos(3\phi)+i\sin(3\phi)$；$i^2=-1$、$i^3=-i$；$\cos^2\phi+\sin^2\phi=1$。

strategy.en: Temporarily write c and s for cosine and sine. Keep powers of i visible until the expansion is grouped into real and imaginary parts.
strategy.zh: 暂时用 c、s 代表余弦、正弦。展开时保留 i 的幂，直到整理为实部与虚部。

steps.en: Put $c=\cos\phi$, $s=\sin\phi$. Then $(c+is)^3=c^3+3ic^2s+3i^2cs^2+i^3s^3=(c^3-3cs^2)+i(3c^2s-s^3)$.
Equate real parts: $\cos(3\phi)=c^3-3cs^2=c^3-3c(1-c^2)=4c^3-3c$.
Equate imaginary parts: $\sin(3\phi)=3c^2s-s^3=3(1-s^2)s-s^3=3s-4s^3$.
Check $\phi=0$: the two formulas give $1$ and $0$. Check $\phi=\pi/2$: they give $0$ and $-1$, agreeing with the angle $3\pi/2$. These are checks, not substitutes for the derivation.
steps.zh: 取 $\phi=0$ 检查，分别得到 $1$ 和 $0$。再取 $\phi=\pi/2$，分别得到 $0$ 和 $-1$，与 $3\pi/2$ 一致。这些只是核对，不能代替一般推导。

say.en: We get two real identities from one complex identity. Which part gives the cosine formula?
say.zh: 一个复数恒等式同时提供两个实数恒等式。哪一部分给出余弦公式？

pitfalls.en: The sign in the imaginary cubic term comes from $i^3=-i$. Also, $\cos^3\phi$ means $(\cos\phi)^3$, not $\cos(3\phi)$.
pitfalls.zh: 虚部三次项的负号来自 $i^3=-i$。此外 $\cos^3\phi$ 表示 $(\cos\phi)^3$，不是 $\cos(3\phi)$。

title: Q1.8 · Recovering sine and cosine from exponentials · 指数表示正弦与余弦
source: Linear Algebra 2026 · Problem Sheet 1 · Q1.8；题意据课程题单核对，以下为独立展开解答，并非官方答案逐字引用。
questionEn: Use Euler’s formula to derive $\sin\phi=(e^{i\phi}-e^{-i\phi})/(2i)$ and $\cos\phi=(e^{i\phi}+e^{-i\phi})/2$.
questionZh: 利用欧拉公式推导 $\sin\phi=(e^{i\phi}-e^{-i\phi})/(2i)$ 和 $\cos\phi=(e^{i\phi}+e^{-i\phi})/2$。

overview.en: Write Euler’s formula for opposite angles. Adding isolates cosine; subtracting isolates sine.
overview.zh: 把欧拉公式分别用于正、负两个角；相加留下余弦，相减留下正弦。

prerequisites.en: $e^{i\phi}=\cos\phi+i\sin\phi$, $\cos(-\phi)=\cos\phi$, and $\sin(-\phi)=-\sin\phi$ for real $\phi$.
prerequisites.zh: 实数 $\phi$ 满足 $e^{i\phi}=\cos\phi+i\sin\phi$、$\cos(-\phi)=\cos\phi$、$\sin(-\phi)=-\sin\phi$。

strategy.en: Treat the two Euler equations as two simultaneous linear equations in cosine and sine. Choose addition or subtraction according to the term to eliminate.
strategy.zh: 把两个欧拉公式看成关于余弦、正弦的联立一次方程。根据想消去的项选择加法或减法。

steps.en: At angle $-\phi$, Euler gives $e^{-i\phi}=\cos\phi-i\sin\phi$.
steps.zh: 对角度 $-\phi$ 使用欧拉公式，得 $e^{-i\phi}=\cos\phi-i\sin\phi$。

steps.en: Add: $e^{i\phi}+e^{-i\phi}=2\cos\phi$. Divide by $2$ to obtain the cosine formula.
steps.zh: 相加：$e^{i\phi}+e^{-i\phi}=2\cos\phi$。除以 $2$，得到余弦公式。

steps.en: Subtract the second equation from the first: $e^{i\phi}-e^{-i\phi}=2i\sin\phi$. Divide by $2i$ to obtain the sine formula.
steps.zh: 第一式减第二式：$e^{i\phi}-e^{-i\phi}=2i\sin\phi$。除以 $2i$，得到正弦公式。

steps.en: Although the expressions contain $i$, the results are real for real $\phi$: the exponential terms are conjugates, so their sum is real and their difference is purely imaginary.
steps.zh: 虽然表达式里有 $i$，但实数 $\phi$ 对应的结果仍为实数：两个指数项互为共轭，所以和为实数，差为纯虚数。

say.en: To remove sine, do we add or subtract? Why does the sine formula need i in the denominator?
say.zh: 想消去正弦应相加还是相减？正弦公式的分母为什么还需要 i？

pitfalls.en: The denominator in the sine formula is $2i$, not $2$. Reversing the numerator’s order reverses the sign.
pitfalls.zh: 正弦公式分母是 $2i$，不是 $2$。把分子两项顺序颠倒会改变符号。

title: Q1.9 · Cosine rule and triangle inequality · 余弦定理与三角不等式
source: Linear Algebra 2026 · Problem Sheet 1 · Q1.9；题意据课程题单核对，以下为独立展开解答，并非官方答案逐字引用。 本页题目为题意改述，含教学澄清（较小夹角、零向量或角度变换），不是官方逐字题面；原题措辞以学校题单为准。
questionEn: Consider a triangle with positive side lengths $a,b,c$ and angle $\gamma$ between the sides of lengths $a,b$. (a) Set $u=(a,0)$ and $v=b(\cos\gamma,\sin\gamma)$; find their norms. (b) Use $\|u-v\|$ to prove $c^2=a^2+b^2-2ab\cos\gamma$. (c) Show $c^2\le(a+b)^2$ and determine equality for $\gamma\in[0,\pi]$. (d) Deduce $\|x+y\|\le\|x\|+\|y\|$; explain the angle change when using $v=-y$, and handle zero vectors.
questionZh: 一个三角形的三边长度 $a,b,c$ 为正数，$a,b$ 两边夹角为 $\gamma$。(a) 令 $u=(a,0)$、$v=b(\cos\gamma,\sin\gamma)$，求长度。(b) 利用 $\|u-v\|$ 证明 $c^2=a^2+b^2-2ab\cos\gamma$。(c) 证明 $c^2\le(a+b)^2$，并在 $\gamma\in[0,\pi]$ 下判断等号条件。(d) 推出 $\|x+y\|\le\|x\|+\|y\|$；说明使用 $v=-y$ 时的夹角变化，并处理零向量。

overview.en: The difference of two arrows from a common origin joins their endpoints. To study a sum, reverse the second arrow first.
overview.zh: 两个同起点箭头的差连接两个终点；要把和转化为差，先反转第二个箭头。

prerequisites.en: $\sin^2\gamma+\cos^2\gamma=1$, $-1\le\cos\gamma\le1$, and norms are nonnegative.
prerequisites.zh: $\sin^2\gamma+\cos^2\gamma=1$、$-1\le\cos\gamma\le1$，且范数非负。

strategy.en: Sketch the common vertex at the origin and the other vertices at u and v. The side of length c is between those endpoints, not from the origin to u+v.
strategy.zh: 把公共顶点放在原点，另外两个顶点放在 u、v 处。长度为 c 的边连接这两个终点，不是从原点指向 u+v 的箭头。

steps.en: (a) $\|u\|=a$ because $a>0$. Also $\|v\|=\sqrt{b^2(\cos^2\gamma+\sin^2\gamma)}=b$ because $b>0$.
steps.zh: (a) 因 $a>0$，$\|u\|=a$。又因 $b>0$，$\|v\|=\sqrt{b^2(\cos^2\gamma+\sin^2\gamma)}=b$。

steps.en: (b) The vector from endpoint $v$ to endpoint $u$ is $u-v=(a-b\cos\gamma,-b\sin\gamma)$; its norm is $c$. Thus $c^2=(a-b\cos\gamma)^2+b^2\sin^2\gamma=a^2+b^2-2ab\cos\gamma$.
steps.zh: (b) 从终点 $v$ 指向终点 $u$ 的向量为 $u-v=(a-b\cos\gamma,-b\sin\gamma)$，其长度为 $c$。因此 $c^2=(a-b\cos\gamma)^2+b^2\sin^2\gamma=a^2+b^2-2ab\cos\gamma$。

steps.en: (c) Since $\cos\gamma\ge-1$ and $ab>0$, $-2ab\cos\gamma\le2ab$. Hence $c^2\le a^2+b^2+2ab=(a+b)^2$. Equality holds exactly when $\cos\gamma=-1$, that is $\gamma=\pi$ in $[0,\pi]$.
steps.zh: (c) 因 $\cos\gamma\ge-1$ 且 $ab>0$，所以 $-2ab\cos\gamma\le2ab$。故 $c^2\le a^2+b^2+2ab=(a+b)^2$。当且仅当 $\cos\gamma=-1$，即 $\gamma=\pi$ 时取等号。

steps.en: This equality is a degenerate triangle: the two rays point in opposite directions and all three vertices are collinear. For a genuine nondegenerate triangle, $0<\gamma<\pi$, so $c<a+b$.
steps.zh: 等号对应退化三角形：两条射线方向相反，三个顶点共线。真正非退化三角形满足 $0<\gamma<\pi$，所以严格有 $c<a+b$。

steps.en: (d) If $x=0$ or $y=0$, the norm inequality is an equality immediately. Otherwise take $u=x$ and $v=-y$, after rotating coordinates if needed. Now $u-v=x+y$, $a=\|x\|$, $b=\|y\|$. Part (c) gives $\|x+y\|^2\le(\|x\|+\|y\|)^2$; take nonnegative square roots.
steps.zh: (d) 若 $x=0$ 或 $y=0$，不等式立即以等号成立。否则取 $u=x$、$v=-y$，必要时旋转坐标轴。此时 $u-v=x+y$，$a=\|x\|$、$b=\|y\|$。由 (c) 得 $\|x+y\|^2\le(\|x\|+\|y\|)^2$，取非负平方根即可。

steps.en: If the angle between nonzero $x,y$ is $\alpha\in[0,\pi]$, the angle between $x,-y$ is $\gamma=\pi-\alpha$. Thus equality $\gamma=\pi$ means $\alpha=0$: $x,y$ point in the same direction. Reversing the arrow reverses this angle condition.
steps.zh: 若非零 $x,y$ 夹角为 $\alpha\in[0,\pi]$，则 $x,-y$ 夹角为 $\gamma=\pi-\alpha$。所以等号条件 $\gamma=\pi$ 对应 $\alpha=0$：原来的 $x,y$ 同向。反转箭头会相应改变夹角条件。

steps.en: The same argument applies in any real Euclidean space: two vectors lie in a plane or a line through the origin; use the planar construction in that span, with collinear cases interpreted as degenerate.
steps.zh: 同样的论证适用于任意实欧氏空间：两个向量位于过原点的某个平面或直线上；在它们张成的空间中使用该构造，共线情形视为退化情况。

say.en: Which side is represented by u minus v? To turn this into a proof about x plus y, which vector must we reverse?
say.zh: u 减 v 对应哪条边？要证明关于 x 加 y 的结论，我们需要反转哪个向量？

pitfalls.en: Equality for the triangle side bound uses opposite rays, but equality for the norm of x+y uses x and y in the same direction. These are consistent because v is minus y.
pitfalls.zh: 三角形边长上界的等号要求两射线反向，向量和范数的等号却要求 x、y 同向；二者并不冲突，因为 v 取的是负 y。

title: Q1.10 · Cauchy–Schwarz and an average · 柯西不等式与平均数
source: Linear Algebra 2026 · Problem Sheet 1 · Q1.10；题意据课程题单核对，以下为独立展开解答，并非官方答案逐字引用。
questionEn: For real numbers $a_1,\ldots,a_N$ and a positive integer $N$, use Cauchy–Schwarz to prove $\left((a_1+\cdots+a_N)/N\right)^2\le(a_1^2+\cdots+a_N^2)/N$.
questionZh: 对实数 $a_1,\ldots,a_N$ 与正整数 $N$，利用柯西–施瓦茨不等式证明 $\left((a_1+\cdots+a_N)/N\right)^2\le(a_1^2+\cdots+a_N^2)/N$。

overview.en: A sum of numbers is a dot product with the all-ones vector. This converts the desired estimate into Cauchy–Schwarz.
overview.zh: 一串数的和就是它们与全一向量的点积；这样就能直接套用柯西–施瓦茨不等式。

strategy.en: First clear the denominator mentally: the target is $(\sum a_j)^2\le N\sum a_j^2$. Match each of these three pieces to a dot product or a squared norm.
strategy.zh: 先想象清去分母：目标为 $(\sum a_j)^2\le N\sum a_j^2$。把这三部分分别匹配成点积或范数平方。

steps.en: Take $u=(a_1,\ldots,a_N)$ and $v=(1,\ldots,1)$. Then $u\cdot v=\sum_{j=1}^N a_j$, $\|u\|^2=\sum_{j=1}^N a_j^2$, and $\|v\|^2=N$.
Cauchy–Schwarz gives $(\sum_{j=1}^N a_j)^2\le N\sum_{j=1}^N a_j^2$. Divide by $N^2>0$ to obtain the requested inequality.
steps.zh: 柯西–施瓦茨给出 $(\sum_{j=1}^N a_j)^2\le N\sum_{j=1}^N a_j^2$。除以正数 $N^2$ 即得题目结论。

steps.en: Equality holds exactly when $u$ is a scalar multiple of the nonzero vector $v$, so $a_1=\cdots=a_N$. The common value may be negative, positive or zero. For $N=1$, equality always holds.
steps.zh: 当且仅当 $u$ 为非零向量 $v$ 的倍数时取等号，即 $a_1=\cdots=a_N$。共同的数值可以为负、正或零。当 $N=1$ 时总取等号。

say.en: How can we turn a sum into a dot product? What is the squared length of the all-ones vector?
say.zh: 如何把一串数的和写成点积？全一向量的长度平方是什么？

pitfalls.en: No assumption that the a values are nonnegative is needed. Divide by N squared, not just N, in the final step.
pitfalls.zh: 不需要假设每个 a 都非负。最后要除以 N 的平方，不是只除以 N。

alternatives.en: Check by variance: let $m=(\sum a_j)/N$. Then $0\le\sum(a_j-m)^2=\sum a_j^2-Nm^2$. This proves the same statement and the same equality condition, but the requested route uses Cauchy–Schwarz.
alternatives.zh: 可用方差核查：令 $m=(\sum a_j)/N$，则 $0\le\sum(a_j-m)^2=\sum a_j^2-Nm^2$。这给出同一结论和等号条件，但题目要求的证明路线是柯西–施瓦茨。

title: Q1.11 · Arithmetic in Q(√2) · 有理数加根号二的数系
source: Linear Algebra 2026 · Problem Sheet 1 · Q1.11；题意据课程题单核对，以下为独立展开解答，并非官方答案逐字引用。
questionEn: Let $\mathbb Q(\sqrt2)=\{x+\sqrt2y:x,y\in\mathbb Q\}$. Show closure under addition and multiplication, and show every nonzero element has its inverse in this set. Deduce closure under division by a nonzero element.
questionZh: 设 $\mathbb Q(\sqrt2)=\{x+\sqrt2y:x,y\in\mathbb Q\}$。证明该集合对加法、乘法封闭，且每个非零元素的乘法逆元仍在其中；由此推出对非零元素的除法封闭。

overview.en: The product stays in the same form because (√2)² is rational. For an inverse, multiply by the expression with the opposite √2 term.
overview.zh: 乘法后仍保持同一形式，因为根号二的平方是有理数。求倒数时乘以根号二项符号相反的表达式。

prerequisites.en: $\mathbb Q$ is closed under addition, subtraction, multiplication and nonzero division; $\sqrt2$ is irrational.
prerequisites.zh: 有理数对加、减、乘和非零除法封闭；$\sqrt2$ 是无理数。

strategy.en: Use generic rational coefficients for two elements. For inversion, finding a formal formula is not enough: explicitly prove its denominator cannot vanish.
strategy.zh: 用一般有理系数表示两个元素。求倒数不能只写形式公式，还必须证明分母不为零。

steps.en: Let $a=x+\sqrt2y$ and $b=u+\sqrt2v$, with $x,y,u,v\in\mathbb Q$. Addition: $a+b=(x+u)+\sqrt2(y+v)$, whose two coefficients are rational.
steps.zh: 令 $a=x+\sqrt2y$、$b=u+\sqrt2v$，四个系数都是有理数。加法：$a+b=(x+u)+\sqrt2(y+v)$，两个系数仍为有理数。

steps.en: Multiplication: $ab=(xu+2yv)+\sqrt2(xv+yu)$, again with rational coefficients. Hence the set is closed under these two operations.
steps.zh: 乘法：$ab=(xu+2yv)+\sqrt2(xv+yu)$，两个系数仍是有理数。因此这两种运算均封闭。

steps.en: Now assume $a=x+\sqrt2y\ne0$. The product with $x-\sqrt2y$ is $x^2-2y^2$. Claim that this rational number is nonzero.
steps.zh: 现在假设 $a=x+\sqrt2y\ne0$。它与 $x-\sqrt2y$ 相乘为 $x^2-2y^2$。需要证明这个有理数不为零。

steps.en:
If $x^2-2y^2=0$ and $y=0$, then $x=0$, contradicting $a
e0$. If $y
e0$, then $(x/y)^2=2$, so $x/y=\pm\sqrt2$, contradicting the rationality of $x/y$. Thus $x^2-2y^2
e0$.
steps.zh: 若 $x^2-2y^2=0$ 且 $y=0$，则 $x=0$，与 $a\ne0$ 矛盾。若 $y\ne0$，则 $(x/y)^2=2$，即 $x/y=\pm\sqrt2$，与 $x/y$ 为有理数矛盾。因此分母不为零。

steps.en: Therefore $a^{-1}=\dfrac{x-\sqrt2y}{x^2-2y^2}=\dfrac{x}{x^2-2y^2}+\sqrt2\dfrac{-y}{x^2-2y^2}$. Both coefficients are rational. Multiplying this formula by $a$ gives $1$, so it really is the inverse.
steps.zh: 所以 $a^{-1}=\dfrac{x-\sqrt2y}{x^2-2y^2}=\dfrac{x}{x^2-2y^2}+\sqrt2\dfrac{-y}{x^2-2y^2}$。两个系数都是有理数；乘回 $a$ 得到 $1$，确认它确实是逆元。

steps.en: If $b\ne0$, then $a/b=a\,b^{-1}$ belongs to the set by inverse closure followed by multiplication closure. Zero is allowed as the numerator but never as the denominator.
steps.zh: 若 $b\ne0$，则 $a/b=a\,b^{-1}$ 先由逆元封闭，再由乘法封闭，仍在集合内。分子可以为零，分母不可以。

steps.en: For example, $1/(1+\sqrt2)=\sqrt2-1$. Check: $(1+\sqrt2)(\sqrt2-1)=1$. Additive inverses also stay in the set: $-a=(-x)+\sqrt2(-y)$.
steps.zh: 例如 $1/(1+\sqrt2)=\sqrt2-1$。代回检查：$(1+\sqrt2)(\sqrt2-1)=1$。加法逆元也留在集合中：$-a=(-x)+\sqrt2(-y)$。

say.en: Why does the denominator not vanish? That is the key step that makes this inverse formula a proof rather than a guess.
say.zh: 分母为什么不会为零？这是让倒数公式成为证明而非猜测的关键一步。

pitfalls.en: The expression $x-\sqrt2y$ is an algebraic conjugate here, not the complex conjugate: these numbers are real. Nonzero input alone does not justify dividing until the denominator has been checked.
pitfalls.zh: 这里的 $x-\sqrt2y$ 是代数共轭，不是复共轭；这些数本来就是实数。不能只说输入非零就跳过对公式分母的检查。

title: Q1.12 · Roots of unity · 单位根
source: Linear Algebra 2026 · Problem Sheet 1 · Q1.12；题意据课程题单核对，以下为独立展开解答，并非官方答案逐字引用。
questionEn: For a positive integer $n$, an nth root of unity is a complex number satisfying $z^n=1$. (a) Prove every such number has modulus 1. (b) Find all roots for $n=2$ and $n=3$ and plot them. (c) Prove there are exactly $n$ roots and describe their arrangement on the unit circle.
questionZh: 对正整数 $n$，满足 $z^n=1$ 的复数叫作 n 次单位根。(a) 证明它们的模均为 1。(b) 求 $n=2$、$n=3$ 的全部单位根并作图。(c) 证明恰有 $n$ 个根，并说明它们在单位圆上的排列。

overview.en: Modulus fixes the circle; the argument condition fixes equally spaced positions around it. Count distinct angles modulo a full turn.
overview.zh: 模决定所在圆，辐角条件决定圆上等间距的位置。数根时要按一整圈取模，避免把同一点重复算入。

prerequisites.en: $|z^n|=|z|^n$; a modulus-one number can be written $e^{i\theta}$; $e^{it}=1$ exactly when $t$ is an integer multiple of $2\pi$.
prerequisites.zh: $|z^n|=|z|^n$；模为 1 的数可写成 $e^{i\theta}$；$e^{it}=1$ 当且仅当 $t$ 是 $2\pi$ 的整数倍。

strategy.en: First constrain the radius; only then solve the angle equation. Give both exhaustiveness and distinctness, not just a list of n candidate solutions.
strategy.zh: 先限制半径，再解角度方程。除列出 n 个候选解，还要说明没有遗漏、没有重复。

steps.en: (a) Take moduli of $z^n=1$: $|z|^n=1$. Since $|z|\ge0$ and $n\ge1$, this forces $|z|=1$. In particular, $z\ne0$.
steps.zh: (a) 两边取模得 $|z|^n=1$。因 $|z|\ge0$ 且 $n\ge1$，必有 $|z|=1$。特别地，$z\ne0$。

steps.en: (b) For $n=2$, the roots are $e^0=1$ and $e^{i\pi}=-1$. Plot at $(1,0)$ and $(-1,0)$ on the real axis: opposite ends of a diameter.
steps.zh: (b) $n=2$ 时，根为 $e^0=1$ 和 $e^{i\pi}=-1$。在实轴上的 $(1,0)$、$(-1,0)$ 标点，它们是同一直径的两个端点。

steps.en: For $n=3$, the roots are $1$, $e^{2\pi i/3}=-\tfrac12+i\tfrac{\sqrt3}{2}$, and $e^{4\pi i/3}=-\tfrac12-i\tfrac{\sqrt3}{2}$. Plot $(1,0)$, $(-1/2,\sqrt3/2)$ and $(-1/2,-\sqrt3/2)$; they form an equilateral triangle centred at the origin.
steps.zh: $n=3$ 时，根为 $1$、$e^{2\pi i/3}=-\tfrac12+i\tfrac{\sqrt3}{2}$、$e^{4\pi i/3}=-\tfrac12-i\tfrac{\sqrt3}{2}$。在 $(1,0)$、$(-1/2,\sqrt3/2)$、$(-1/2,-\sqrt3/2)$ 标点，连成以原点为中心的正三角形。

steps.en: (c) Write any root as $z=e^{i\theta}$. Then $e^{in\theta}=1$, so $n\theta=2\pi k$ for some integer $k$. Thus every root is $e^{2\pi i k/n}$. Conversely each such number has nth power $e^{2\pi i k}=1$.
