steps.zh: (c) 把任一根写成 $z=e^{i\theta}$。则 $e^{in\theta}=1$，因此存在整数 $k$ 使 $n\theta=2\pi k$。所以每个根都形如 $e^{2\pi i k/n}$；反过来，这样的数的 n 次方确实等于 $1$。

steps.en: Reduce $k$ modulo $n$: only $k=0,1,\ldots,n-1$ are needed. If two of these give the same root, $e^{2\pi i(k-\ell)/n}=1$, so $k-\ell$ is a multiple of $n$. But $|k-\ell|<n$, hence $k=\ell$. There are exactly $n$ distinct roots.
steps.zh: 把 $k$ 模 $n$，只需保留 $k=0,1,\ldots,n-1$。若其中两个给出同一根，则 $e^{2\pi i(k-\ell)/n}=1$，所以 $k-\ell$ 为 $n$ 的整数倍。又因 $|k-\ell|<n$，只能 $k=\ell$。因此恰有 $n$ 个不同根。

steps.en: Their arguments are $0,2\pi/n,\ldots,2\pi(n-1)/n$, so successive points have angular separation $2\pi/n$. For $n\ge3$ they are the vertices of a regular n-gon; $n=1$ gives just $1$, and $n=2$ gives a diametrically opposite pair.
steps.zh: 辐角依次为 $0,2\pi/n,\ldots,2\pi(n-1)/n$，相邻点相隔 $2\pi/n$。当 $n\ge3$ 时形成正 n 边形顶点；$n=1$ 仅有 $1$，$n=2$ 是一对直径端点。

say.en: Why do we stop at n minus one? What happens if we include k equals n?
say.zh: 为什么 k 只取到 n 减一？如果再取 k 等于 n，会发生什么？

pitfalls.en: $k=n$ repeats $k=0$. Taking only the real nth root misses complex roots. Use equal axis scales when plotting the unit circle.
pitfalls.zh: $k=n$ 重复了 $k=0$。只取实数意义的 n 次根会漏掉复数根。单位圆作图时两轴应使用同一比例。

title: Q1.13 · Reading the triangle-inequality proof · 读懂三角不等式证明
source: Linear Algebra 2026 · Problem Sheet 1 · Q1.13；题意据课程题单核对，以下为独立展开解答，并非官方答案逐字引用。
questionEn: Explain the proof of the Euclidean triangle inequality $\|v+w\|\le\|v\|+\|w\|$: (a) Which dot-product properties justify expanding $(v+w)\cdot(v+w)$? (b) Why does Cauchy–Schwarz, stated with $|v\cdot w|$, provide the required upper bound on $v\cdot w$? (c) Why may we take square roots at the end?
questionZh: 解释欧氏范数三角不等式 $\|v+w\|\le\|v\|+\|w\|$ 的证明：(a) 展开 $(v+w)\cdot(v+w)$ 使用了点积的哪些性质？(b) 带绝对值的柯西–施瓦茨不等式为何能给出对 $v\cdot w$ 所需的上界？(c) 最后为什么可以开平方？

overview.en: This is a proof-reading exercise: justify every transition, especially the inequality and square-root steps, rather than simply restating the final theorem.
overview.zh: 本题重点是读懂证明：说明每次变形的理由，特别是不等号和开平方两步，而不是重复结论。

prerequisites.en: Real dot products are bilinear and symmetric; $\|v\|^2=v\cdot v$; $|v\cdot w|\le\|v\|\|w\|$.
prerequisites.zh: 实数点积具有双线性和对称性；$\|v\|^2=v\cdot v$；$|v\cdot w|\le\|v\|\|w\|$。

strategy.en: Annotate the proof with the name of the rule used on each line. Distinguish an equality from a bound and check nonnegativity before taking roots.
strategy.zh: 在证明每一行旁标注使用的规则；分清等式与估计，并在开平方前检查非负性。

steps.en: (a) Distributivity in both arguments gives $(v+w)\cdot(v+w)=v\cdot v+v\cdot w+w\cdot v+w\cdot w$. Symmetry combines the middle terms into $2v\cdot w$; the norm identity replaces the self-products.
steps.zh: (a) 对两个位置分别使用分配律，得到 $(v+w)\cdot(v+w)=v\cdot v+v\cdot w+w\cdot v+w\cdot w$。对称性把中间两项合成 $2v\cdot w$，范数恒等式替换自点积。

steps.en: Thus $\|v+w\|^2=\|v\|^2+2v\cdot w+\|w\|^2$. No inequality has been used yet.
steps.zh: 于是 $\|v+w\|^2=\|v\|^2+2v\cdot w+\|w\|^2$。到这里还没有使用任何不等式。

steps.en: (b) Every real $t$ satisfies $t\le|t|$. Therefore $v\cdot w\le|v\cdot w|\le\|v\|\|w\|$. This works whether the dot product is positive, zero or negative.
steps.zh: (b) 任意实数 $t$ 都满足 $t\le|t|$。所以 $v\cdot w\le|v\cdot w|\le\|v\|\|w\|$。点积为正、零或负时，这个推导都成立。

steps.en: Multiply that bound by the positive number $2$ and substitute into the expansion: $\|v+w\|^2\le\|v\|^2+2\|v\|\|w\|+\|w\|^2=(\|v\|+\|w\|)^2$.

(c) Both $A=\|v+w\|$ and $B=\|v\|+\|w\|$ are nonnegative. The square-root function is increasing on $[0,\infty)$, so $A^2\le B^2$ implies $A\le B$. Here $\sqrt{B^2}=B$, not an ambiguous plus-or-minus value.
steps.zh: (c) $A=\|v+w\|$ 与 $B=\|v\|+\|w\|$ 都非负。平方根函数在 $[0,\infty)$ 上递增，所以 $A^2\le B^2$ 推出 $A\le B$。这里 $\sqrt{B^2}=B$，不是带任意正负号的数。

steps.en: No division by a norm occurs, so the proof already includes zero vectors. Optional equality check: it requires $v\cdot w=\|v\|\|w\|$, which means same direction for two nonzero vectors, or one is zero.
steps.zh: 整个证明没有除以范数，因此已经包含零向量。可选等号检查：需满足 $v\cdot w=\|v\|\|w\|$，即两个非零向量同向，或某个向量为零。

say.en: Where does the first inequality enter the proof? Why is it still valid when the dot product is negative?
say.zh: 证明第一次出现不等号在哪里？如果点积为负，这一步为什么仍然成立？

pitfalls.en: Do not replace $v\cdot w$ by $|v\cdot w|$ using an equality. Also $A^2\le B^2$ does not imply $A\le B$ for arbitrary signed real numbers; nonnegativity is essential.
pitfalls.zh: 不能用等号把 $v\cdot w$ 替换成 $|v\cdot w|$。此外对任意带符号实数，$A^2\le B^2$ 并不推出 $A\le B$；非负性是关键。

strategy.zh: 简短说明后，先让学生尝试画出 $2-i$。根据他们的卡点补必要概念，再请学生解释。

strategy.en: Use A2–A5 as the main path; A6 is optional. Start the closing at 09:47 in the proposed 09:00 session plan. Do not rush through all Q1.2–Q1.13.
strategy.zh: A2–A5 为主线，A6 可选。按 09:00 开始的备课方案，在 09:47 收尾；不必赶着讲完 Q1.2–Q1.13。

steps.en: Quiz 1 and hand-in Q1.1 are both due on Wednesday 30 September 2026 at 12 noon, UK local time. Check the live course page again if the course team announces changes.
steps.zh: Quiz 1 与待交题 Q1.1 均于 2026 年 9 月 30 日周三英国当地时间中午 12 点截止。若教师有后续通知，以实时课程页面为准。

steps.en: The Numbas quiz is assessed; repeated attempts are allowed and the best completed attempt counts. Hand-in Q1.1 does not contribute to the final grade. Tutors record submission out of 1 (1 for submitting an attempt), rather than grading correctness; an incomplete attempt is worth submitting.
steps.zh: Numbas quiz 计分，可多次尝试，取已完成尝试中的最高分。Hand-in Q1.1 不计入总评；导师用满分 1 分记录提交情况（提交尝试记 1），不是按正确程度评分。没完全做完也应提交。

steps.en: The Week 1 teacher guidance says not to go through the hand-in solution in this tutorial. Offer starting questions, not the final parameter or proof. The full C1 solution is here for your preparation, collapsed by default.
steps.zh: 教师 Week 1 建议要求本周不要完整讲待交题答案。可以给起步问题，不给最终参数或完整证明。C1 全解供你备课，默认折叠。

steps.en: Additional-question hints and solutions are available immediately. On 24 September, opening Q1.1’s Reveal Solution on the linked student-visible HTML sheet showed only a notice that solutions will be available after the submission deadline, not a worked answer. The precise publication time is not stated.
steps.zh: 附加题的提示和答案可立即查看。9 月 24 日打开学生可见入口链接的 HTML 题单，Q1.1 的 Reveal Solution 只有“截止后提供答案”的说明，没有完整解答；未写具体发布时间。

steps.en: A1–A6 are tutor activity labels, not the formal additional-question numbers. No separate A1–A6 answer resource was found in the inspected Learning activities list or Problem Sheet 1; this is not a claim that no equivalent example exists anywhere on Blackboard.
steps.zh: A1–A6 是教师活动的本地编号，不是正式附加题号。在已检查的 Learning activities 列表和题单 1 中未找到单独的 A1–A6 答案资源；这不意味着 Blackboard 所有材料都没有类似例子。

steps.en: For Q1.1(a), a starting hint is: write u+v in coordinates, then calculate the three lengths separately. For (b), try three vectors first and ask how to group them to apply the two-vector triangle inequality. Leave the final parameter, complete inequality chain and equality example to the student.
steps.zh: Q1.1(a) 的入手提示：先写 u+v 的坐标，再分别算三个长度。(b) 可先试三个向量，想怎样分组使用两个向量的三角不等式。最终参数、完整不等式链和取等例子留给学生。

say.en: Please complete Quiz 1 and submit your attempt at Question 1.1 by Wednesday at noon. The quiz is graded; the written work is for feedback. If you get stuck, show your working and tell us where the difficulty starts.
say.zh: 请在周三中午前完成 Quiz 1 并提交 Q1.1 的尝试。quiz 计分，纸面作业用于反馈。卡住时也写出过程，说明从哪里开始不理解。

pitfalls.en: Do not project the complete tutor reference or share it as the student handout: it contains solutions. A public URL and a collapsed answer are not access controls.
pitfalls.zh: 完整教师参考资料含答案，不适合直接投屏或作为学生题单分发。公开链接与折叠答案都不是权限控制。

pitfalls.en: This is a teaching plan, not a fresh confirmation of your room or timetable. Ask which definitions students have met if lecture streams differ.
pitfalls.zh: 这里是教学方案，不是对教室或课表的重新确认。不同 lecture stream 进度可能不同，开场先确认他们已经学到哪些定义。
